body: **Marker:** 2026-11-15-live-round-on-the-trimmed-product · **Version:** viola-0.2.0 · **Epoch:** Epoch 2 — The budget gate and the status line leave (its last entry) · **Working entry:** chk-td5nhkqf
Live round on the trimmed product — v1-27's wrapped start proved; a dialog hold near its 3600 s ceiling read, the PROVISIONAL mark settled

The first live round on the product with the budget gate and the status-line interception removed: the rigs that drive
real `claude` headless on a plain pty the rig opens itself, each rehearsed under the fake agent first, then a set of
NAMED operator steps (`leg = 'operator'`), each with its live-start count, fired only on the operator's word for it.
The live readings it owes:

- **The wrapped start (matrix v2-03, the 0.2.0 heir of 0.1.0's deferred v1-27).** One live wrapped start of the
  unmodified `claude` on Linux: the child's screen with no byte of viola's own on the rig's pty, the human's keys
  passed unchanged, the pinned copy run through a freshly written plugin by absolute path, the documented start order
  with no budget step, a live or stale name refused, the child's end detected on the process, on a ledger that reads
  green for the founder's account (`cli_verified:true`).

- **The dialog hold near its ceiling (matrix v2-02).** A live dialog hold read close to the 3600 s ceiling
  (`DIALOG_HOLD_MAX`, residual res-ujtjay7k, PROVISIONAL), on record, so the ceiling stands on that reading or moves to
  the value read, its PROVISIONAL mark gone — the settling itself is the founder's word (below).

- **CARRY 1 (cry-jh4ipw7f):** re-record `fixtures/claude/2.1.302/Mcp.tools-list-1.json` so the MCP `list` tool's
  description drops «and the usage budget» — a live `claude` start through `viola-mcp-tap`, a named operator step of
  this round (found at chunk 2026-11-14-budget-gate-removed's P5 card; placed by the operator's wrap directive,
  chunks/2026-11-14-budget-gate-removed/inputs/I7-wrap-budget-gate-removed-directive.md.txt item 4, row 1 of
  .andromeda/runs/2026-11-14T14-40-00-phase/p5-card-1.md «Beyond the plan»).

- **CARRY 2 (cry-iplgskto):** a box-only screen fixture (the input box's rule and prompt rows with no footer literal,
  recorded by a clean `viola verify --record`) for the fake agent to replay in CI — the status-line rows that blocked a
  clean `--record` are retired, so this round's live start can carry one; none is hand-written (carried from chunk
  2026-11-13-verify-readiness-on-the-input-box through chunk 2026-11-14-status-line-interception-removed; placed by
  chunks/2026-11-14-status-line-interception-removed/inputs/I10-wrap-status-line-removed-directive.md.txt item 4, row 1
  of .andromeda/runs/2026-11-14T19-10-38-phase/p5-card-2.md «Beyond the plan»).

- **CARRY 3 (cry-533ioj3s):** read a wrapped session's status line beside an unwrapped one's on a real `claude` —
  matrix v2-05's «exactly as unwrapped» is proven by construction (no `--settings`, no `settings.json`, the hook word
  unknown); the live reading is owed (chunk 2026-11-14-status-line-interception-removed; placed by the same directive
  I10, item 4, row 4 of .andromeda/runs/2026-11-14T19-10-38-phase/p5-card-2.md «Beyond the plan»). The reading READS
  the user's own status-line setting and writes nothing to `~/.claude/settings.json`.

- [inferred] The operator directive for this phase (`~/dev/projects/additional/viola-overseer/phase-live-round-directive.md`,
  snapped below) holds: the phase runs to the P5 card and stops — no implement follows it in this window; four items
  are the founder's own caps and words, WRITTEN to `{run_dir}/founder-forks.md` with options priced, never answered by
  the builder or a delegate, the plan written so each fills by one line without a re-plan: (1) the live-`claude` cap for
  this chunk, the exact live-start count per item, measured, and the total, with what a smaller number still closes;
  (2) the per-chunk word that a rig may type into its own pty (arrow + Enter on a trust dialog), each rig that needs it
  and what it does without it; (3) which CLI the round runs (the builder's shim pins 2.1.296, PATH `claude` newer, the
  fixture dir `fixtures/claude/2.1.302/`), the three versions measured and each choice priced; (4) the 3600 s hold's
  PROVISIONAL mark, the reading that settles it and the options once it exists.

- [inferred] Live sessions run HEADLESS on a plain pty the rig opens itself: no nested compositor, no terminal window,
  no desktop step; the session is never locked or unlocked. Homes are test homes on tmpfs
  (`target/e2e-home/viola-live-*`; `df -h /tmp` read first). Nothing is written under `~/.viola/` or to
  `~/.claude/settings.json`; the pinned product binary (`~/.local/viola-product/bin/viola`, `~/.viola/bin/0.1.0-…`) is
  untouched. Every spawn has a kill deadline.

- [inferred] Order: implement builds the rigs and their fake rehearsals first and stops at the first live step; every
  non-live step and every gate that can go green without a live start comes before it.

- [inferred] The hour-long hold keeps a window idle past the CLI's ≈55-minute compact: the step journals its state in
  the work dir before the wait and names what a resumed window re-reads.

- [inferred] No mutation run. A guard test carries its remove-the-guard control through `gate.py control`, its `case`

- [inferred] An absence assertion in any gate entry (an identifier probe, a `lacks`, an `expect exit 1`) is run at P4

- [inferred] A red or defect found now folds into THIS chunk as an `[inferred]` item with its own acceptance; one found

- [inferred] No cargo build and no test run in the research but what the plan cannot be written without, each named on

- Out of scope: any product behaviour change beyond a defect a live reading exposes (folded per the line above); the
  operator's desk clean-up of the live home's stale `~/.viola/budget.json`, `instances/*/settings.json` overrides and
  `statusline-source.json` (the handoff's, no route entry); the unpin of `vb.sh`'s 2.1.296 shim (the operator's).

- [inferred] The live-round rig(s) — the test-only `viola-e2e` crate (`viola-harness`, `viola-mcp-tap`) and

- [inferred] `viola verify --record` and the fixture class `fixtures/claude/<cli-version>/` (a new `Screen.*` fixture,
  the `Mcp.tools-list-1.json` re-record), with the `--record` scrub.

- [inferred] `DialogHold` / `DIALOG_HOLD_MAX` (60–3600 s, `config.json`'s `dialog_hold_s`) — read, not changed, unless

- [inferred] The capability ledger's stamps for the CLI the round runs (`viola verify` on a test home).
- Evidence: the chunk's `{work_dir}/evidence/` (a live-round record per operator step).

- v2-02 (the dialog-hold ceiling read live) and v2-03 (`viola run` wraps the unmodified CLI on Linux, proved) are this
  entry's caps by their requirement lines; both rest on a live start the founder's cap (fork 1) bounds — a GATED claim
  on the operator's own word is the lean, decided at P4/P5.
- v2-05 is verified; CARRY 3's reading adds its live half as evidence, no re-claim.

- `56c997145c53` (the last wrap's flip, HEAD): `in progress` — checks 7/7, run ci#43687184962 in_progress, the oldest

body:
# Phase directive — «Live round on the trimmed product» (Epoch 2's last entry, viola-0.2.0)

1. Scope is the route entry and its three CARRYs as they stand: v1-27's wrapped start proved; a dialog hold read near
   its 3600 s ceiling; the MCP `list` fixture re-recorded through `viola-mcp-tap`; a box-only screen fixture by a
   clean `viola verify --record`; a wrapped session's status line read beside an unwrapped one's on a real `claude`.
   Re-test every coordinate.
2. The operator is ASLEEP and this phase runs to the P5 card and stops; NO implement follows it. Four things in this
   entry are HIS own caps and words by his standing rule — they are WRITTEN, never answered, not by you and not by a
   delegate. Put each as a row of `{run_dir}/founder-forks.md` with its options priced, and go on planning around it:
   - **the live-`claude` cap for this chunk** — give the EXACT count of live starts per item (measure it: what one
     `viola verify --record` costs in starts, what a wrapped start, a tap run, the hold, the paired reading each
     cost), the total, and what the round can still close with a smaller number (which items drop to a CARRY);
   - **the per-chunk word that a rig may type into its own pty** (arrow + Enter on a trust dialog) — name each rig
     that needs it and what it does without it;
   - **which CLI the round runs** — the builder's shim pins 2.1.296, PATH `claude` is newer, the fixture dir is
     `fixtures/claude/2.1.302/`: measure the three versions and price each choice (a stamp, a re-record, a new
     fixture dir);
   - **the 3600 s hold's PROVISIONAL mark** — what reading settles it and the options once it exists.
   The plan is written so that each of the four can be filled in by one line without a re-plan.
3. Everything technical is yours and the overseer's: each live step is a NAMED operator step (`leg = 'operator'`)
   with its start count, fired only on the operator's word for it; every rig is rehearsed under the FAKE agent with
   no live start; live sessions run HEADLESS on a plain pty the rig opens itself — no nested compositor, no terminal
   window, no desktop step, and the session is never unlocked or locked; the homes are test homes on tmpfs
   (`target/e2e-home/viola-live-*`; read `df -h /tmp` first); NOTHING is written under `~/.viola/` or to
   `~/.claude/settings.json` (the status-line reading READS the user's setting); the pinned product binary
   (`~/.local/viola-product/bin/viola`, `~/.viola/bin/0.1.0-…`) is untouched.
4. **Order the steps so that implement builds the rigs and their fake rehearsals first and STOPS at the first live
   step**: every non-live step and every gate that can go green without a live start comes before it.
5. The hour-long hold keeps a window idle past the CLI's ≈55-minute compact: the step journals its state in the run
   dir BEFORE the wait and names what a resumed window re-reads. Every spawn has a kill deadline.
6. No mutation run. A guard test carries its remove-the-guard control through `gate.py control`, its `case` the
   test's NAME alone.
7. An absence assertion in any gate entry (an identifier probe, a `lacks`, an `expect exit 1`) is run at P4 over the
   plan's OWN text — every fixture key, test name and `contains` atom the plan introduces — before the card.
8. A red or a defect found now folds into THIS chunk as an `[inferred]` item with its own acceptance; one found at P3
   outside the pinned scope is a Carry-forward naming its owner entry.
9. The host: no cargo build and no test run in the research but what the plan cannot be written without; name each
   on the card with its wall time.
10. Run the phase exactly as the letters say. On the P5 card, in one block, verbatim where a tool printed it: the
    union's `picked {n} of {N}` per master with «by every draw» and the `rows-union` line; whether EVERY row the plan
    cites is in the union or its `*-standing.md`; every `[RETYPED]` line and `[EVERY_ROW]` re-spawn; the P4
    self-check's lines for checks 4 (2), 4 (6) and 8; the form of any sealed-run read you made (`rec.py runs …`);
    every non-zero exit, refusal, `UNPARSED` / `INDETERMINATE` / `NOT DERIVED` line, and every place a letter was
    wrong or silent; and a table: item · live starts · rig · what it records.

body:
- **Depth:** moderate (the chunk writes rigs and readings, not product code; the product surfaces they read were read
  at their source) · **Reads:** 21 · **Globs/Greps:** 19

- **Harness rules consulted:** `.claude/rules/verification-harness.md` — read whole (74 lines), its 19 Session
  Additions applied: 2026-10-10 (a live rig puts the chosen CLI's install dir first on PATH and reads `claude
  --version` by path before each start; `--mcp-config` is variadic, so the prompt goes on stdin; a newer `mise` install
  moves the proof only on the operator's word), 2026-10-20 (`target/debug/viola` is a hard link cargo re-points per
  feature set: read the build's hash right before each start), 2026-10-07 (a stalled-start red on the tmpfs homes is
  a finding about the backing, never re-run), 2026-10-11 (`schema-check` reads kept homes only), 2026-11-14 (a refused
  recorder reply is read raw once by hand before any code change), 2026-10-14 (a fake-agent side effect goes after the
  turn's screen write).
- **Platform issues consulted:** none — no runner-only bullet and no CI-reading entry outside the operator leg.

- **External inputs:** `inputs#I1` — the operator directive for this phase (run to the P5 card and stop; four founder
  forks written, never answered; live steps operator-named; headless tmpfs rigs; ordering; no mutation run).

- `src/cmd/verify.rs` (1–60, 290–300, 440–583) — `--record <dir>` writes the WHOLE set of the CLI version it ran
  under `<dir>/<version>/` (spine payloads, dialog, framing, resume and agents variants, `Screen.{modal,ready,turn}.json`)
  only when 0 rows fail; a dirty payload or screen refuses the whole recording (`refuse_recording`, code
  `unclean-fixture`). `screens()` (575–582) records three phases only: `modal`, `ready`, `turn`.

- `src/cmd/verify/typed.rs` (1–60) and `src/cmd/verify/typed/runs.rs` (25–200, by grep) — the five interactive runs A–E;
  `box_only_guards` counted at `runs.rs:63–85` through `turns.rs:79` `guard`.

- `src/run/dialog.rs` (240–265, 365–470) — a hold happens only when `cli_verified && no pending && !unanswerable &&
  wheel holder == Driver` (`dialog.rs:251`); expiry writes one `dialog-expired` line and `dialog-answered{deadline_hit:
  true, duration_ms}` (`record_expiry`, 372–394); `answer` refuses `unverified-cli` on an unverified CLI (435).

- `crates/viola-core/src/lib.rs` (10–30) — `DIALOG_HOLD_DEFAULT` 60 s, `DIALOG_HOLD_MIN` 60 s, `DIALOG_HOLD_MAX` 3600 s,
  each doc-commented PROVISIONAL; the MAX's comment reads «measured live only to about 660 s» (line 26).
- `src/cmd/hook.rs` (50–62) — the dialog hook's own deadline is `DIALOG_HOLD_MAX + REPLY_GRACE` (5 s).
- `plugin/hooks/hooks.json` (lines 10, 13) — the two dialog-tier hooks carry `timeout` 3615.

- `crates/viola-e2e/src/bin/viola-mcp-tap.rs` (1–80) — `record <capture> <viola exe> <args…>` spawns `viola mcp` directly
  and tees each line to a 0600 capture; `fixture <capture> <out>` keeps the client frames up to the first `tools/list`
  and each request's result, scrubbed, refusing by file name and closed code.

- `crates/viola-e2e/tests/mcp_recorded_exchange.rs` (150–230) — walks every `fixtures/claude/*/Mcp.*.json` and asserts
  the served `tools/list` result's key/type shape, the tool names `send wait last answer list`, and the `ttlMs` /
  `cacheScope` controls; it does NOT compare `description` text, so the stale «and the usage budget» description
  (`fixtures/claude/2.1.302/Mcp.tools-list-1.json:190`, grep `usage budget` over `crates src fixtures`: 1 hit) fails
  no test today — CARRY 1 is a fidelity re-record, not a red.

- `fixtures/claude/2.1.302/` (28 files, `ls | wc -l`) and `fixtures/claude/2.1.287/` — every recorded
  `Screen.{ready,turn}.json` keeps a footer-literal row (`⏵⏵ auto mode on (shift+tab to cycle) · ← for agents` on
  2.1.302; `⏸ manual mode on · ← for agents` on 2.1.287): no box-only screen fixture stands in the tree.

- `tests/contract_ledger_probes.rs:41` — `const STAMPED: [&str; 2] = ["2.1.287", "2.1.302"]`: the fake-agent stamping
  reads these two recorded sets.

- `.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-06-version-done-check/evidence/live-pty.py` (171 lines, read whole),
  `live-ledger.py` (33 lines), `live-round.md`, `live-sessions.ndjson` — the 0.1.0 round's rig (a plain pty, 210×45,
  drained and discarded, nothing written before its stop, the stop as Ctrl-C every 500 ms then SIGKILL at 10 s, a
  declared environment with no `CLAUDE*`/`VIOLA*` name) and its ledger. The round read start, fd table and
  killed-wrapper green and the hold unread (unverified CLI after a red verify).

- `.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-10-20-epoch-5-cleanup-ii/evidence/live-tap.py`, `live-tap.md`, `live-sessions.ndjson`
  (restored by `rec.py files`) — the CARRY-1 vehicle: `claude -p --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config <priv>/mcp.json` with
  the prompt on stdin, the MCP server `viola-mcp-tap record <priv>/capture.ndjson target/debug/viola --home <vhome>
  mcp`, from a `proj/` dir, one live start.

- Host reads (no session started, nothing written): `command -v claude` → `~/.local/viola-claude-pin/bin/claude`, a link
  to the `mise` 2.1.296 install, `claude --version` → `2.1.296 (Claude Code)`; `mise ls claude` → 2.1.287 … 2.1.325,
  `latest` = **2.1.325** (the handoff's «2.1.323 is latest» has moved); the live home's `~/.viola/ledger/stamps.json`
  read only (shapes and counts, no write): 2.1.296 24/24 pass (verified_at 2026-10-19), 2.1.302 19/24 (2026-11-09; red
  `tag-escaping`, `local-command-clear`, `paste-newline`, `local-command-compact` and the retired
  `statusline-rate-limits`), 2.1.312 and 2.1.319 19/24 (2026-11-09, the same five), 2.1.323 23/24 (2026-11-13, red the
  retired `statusline-rate-limits` alone; `box_only_guards` 3); `df -h /tmp` → tmpfs 32G, 16G available (above the
  9 GiB floor); `target/e2e-home` → `/tmp/viola-e2e-home-1000` (`findmnt` FSTYPE `tmpfs`); `~/.claude/settings.json`
  holds a `statusLine` object with keys `command`, `type` (read as key names only); `python3 -c "import pyte"` →
  ModuleNotFoundError (no terminal model on the host for a Python rig).

- **`DIALOG_HOLD_MAX`** — 6 references (`refs`, trace `tree-query-2026-11-15-live-round-on-the-trimmed-product.json`):
  `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/lib.rs:444` (the hooks.json-timeout test), `crates/viola-core/src/lib.rs:448` (the
  constant's own test), `src/cmd/hook.rs:22,60,778,785` (the hook's deadline and its two tests). With
  `plugin/hooks/hooks.json:10,13` (3615) these are the whole set a move of the ceiling on fork (4) would touch; settling
  the mark with the value unchanged touches only the doc comment at `crates/viola-core/src/lib.rs:24–26`.
- No other product symbol changes: every rig reads the product from outside (its CLI, its files, `/proc`).

- **Live rigs live in the chunk's evidence, copied byte for byte from the round before** (2026-11-06 plan step 8:
  `live-pty.py` and `live-ledger.py` from 2026-10-19, `cmp` exit 0; 2026-10-20 `live-tap.py`): readers print codes,
  counts, booleans and durations only; every start is ledgered (`live-ledger.py`, `written_at` from the clock) before it
  is made.

- **The verify cost** — a real-CLI `viola verify` is six `claude` sessions (the print-mode probe and Runs A–E) plus two
  non-session spawns (`--version`, Run B's `claude agents --json`): `typed.rs:1–17`, decision/verify-child-set, the
  arch history's 2026-10-14 item («one re-stamp costs six live starts»).

- **A hold needs a verified CLI and the driver's wheel** (`src/run/dialog.rs:251`): the round's home must be stamped
  green for the CLI the round runs BEFORE the wrapped start, and no rig key may stand between the release and the send.

- **The question dialog is the hold's dialog on this host** (2026-11-06 `live-round.md`, `inputs#I5` there): the
  user-level settings allow `Bash(*)`, so a shell command raises no PermissionRequest; an `AskUserQuestion` raises the
  PreToolUse `question` dialog.

- **Trust** — an in-tree cwd inherits the repository root's trust and met no dialog on 2.1.287 (2026-11-06); a cwd on
  the tmpfs that is its own git repo met the folder-trust dialog, passed by at most 2 arrows and 1 Enter typed into the
  rig's own pty on a read `selected` (2026-10-18, security history item 4); an in-tree `proj/` met the external-imports
  modal (2026-10-17).

- **Rig environment** (live-pty.py `KEPT`): `HOME USER LOGNAME SHELL PATH LANG XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` + `TERM`; no `CLAUDE*`,
  no `VIOLA*`; `--home` always given (`live-pty.py:33,40–43`).

- **The stop**: Ctrl-C every 500 ms, SIGKILL of the group at 10 s (`live-pty.py:31–32,121–138`) — every spawn's kill
  deadline.

- **Fixtures**: `--record` from a clean verify only, scrubbed, refused whole if unclean; never hand-written (standing
  S1 of layouts and security, S3 of tests and arch).

- **Homes**: `target/e2e-home/viola-live-*` on the owner-only tmpfs base, 0700 dirs, 0600 files, outside the scan of
  no gate (obs history item 20: homes under the scan root).

- `.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-15-live-round-on-the-trimmed-product/evidence/` — the rigs (copied `live-pty.py`,
  `live-ledger.py`, `live-tap.py`; new `live-hold.py`, `live-read.py`), the rehearsal and live records
  (`rehearsal.md`, `live-round.md`, `live-sessions.ndjson`, `hold-journal.md`)
- derived `fixtures/claude/*/Screen.*.json` by `viola verify --record` — the box-only screen fixture of the CLI the round runs, landing only if the recorded ready screen is box-only
- `fixtures/claude/2.1.302/Mcp.tools-list-1.json` — re-recorded through `viola-mcp-tap` (CARRY 1), only on fork (3)'s 2.1.302 arm
- `crates/viola-core/src/lib.rs` — the `DIALOG_HOLD_MAX` doc comment's PROVISIONAL clause, only on fork (4)'s word after the reading
- `usage budget` over `crates src fixtures` (`/usr/bin/grep -rn`): 1 hit · 1 changed by CARRY 1's re-record · 0 no-change.

body:
_Generated by /andromeda-phase P4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not
edit during an /implement run._
- **Marker:** 2026-11-15-live-round-on-the-trimmed-product · **Version:** viola-0.2.0 · **Generated:** 2026-11-15T07:37:12Z

The first live round on the product with the budget gate and the status-line interception gone. It reads, on a real
`claude`, what 0.1.0's round could not: one wrapped start that is verified (matrix v2-03, the heir of the deferred
v1-27) and a dialog hold read near its 3600 s ceiling (matrix v2-02), and it takes the three CARRYs' live readings —
the MCP `list` fixture re-recorded through `viola-mcp-tap`, a box-only screen fixture from a clean
`viola verify --record`, and a wrapped session's status line read beside an unwrapped one's. It changes no product
behaviour: every rig reads the product from outside (its CLI, its files, `/proc`), per
(architecture · decision/real-cli-probe-local-only) and (test-plan · decision/live-readings-not-a-test-layer).

The round is built so that /implement makes the rigs and rehearses each one under the FAKE agent first, then STOPS at
the first live step (`inputs#I1` item 4). Every live step is a NAMED operator entry (`leg = 'operator'`) carrying its
live-start count, fired only on the operator's word for it. Four things are the founder's own words, written to the run
dir's `founder-forks.md` and never answered here (`inputs#I1` item 2): the live-start cap, the keys a rig may type into
its own pty, which CLI the round runs, and the 3600 s ceiling's PROVISIONAL mark. Each fills ONE line of
`{work_dir}/evidence/founder-words.md`, which every live rig reads before it starts anything: a fork answered by one
line, no re-plan.

1. **The evidence dir and the copied rigs** (`.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-15-live-round-on-the-trimmed-product/evidence/`).
   Fire `rec.py files` for 2026-11-06-version-done-check and 2026-10-20-epoch-5-cleanup-ii first, then copy
   `live-pty.py` and `live-ledger.py` byte for byte from the first (gate entry 1 reads `cmp` exit 0 on each). Copy
   `live-tap.py` from the second and change ONE thing in it: `CLI_VERSION` is read from the `cli:` line of
   `founder-words.md` instead of the literal `2.1.302`; record the `diff` of the two files in `evidence/rigs.md`.
   Keeps arch S1, S4 (a rig lives outside the product and the release build), tests S2.

2. **`founder-words.md`** (same dir). Write exactly four lines, each `unanswered` until the founder's word fills it:
   `cap: unanswered` · `keys: trust unanswered · input-box unanswered` · `cli: unanswered` · `hold: unanswered`.
   The forms each answer takes are in `founder-forks.md` (run dir). Every live subcommand of steps 3–4 reads this file
   first and refuses (exit 3, `refused: word {fork} unanswered`, nothing started) when the line it needs is
   `unanswered`, and refuses when the starts already ledgered plus the step's own count pass `cap:`.

3. **`live-hold.py`** (new rig, same dir) — the driver of every live and rehearsed session, a direct-spawn Python
   script run from the repository root under live-pty.py's declared environment (no `CLAUDE*`, no `VIOLA*`, the chosen
   CLI's install dir first on `PATH`, `--home` always given). Subcommands, each printing ONE closing line
   `{subcommand}: green|red|unread — {codes}` and nothing that holds a path, prompt, assistant text, id or pid:
   - `rehearse-verify` · `live-verify` — a fresh home `target/e2e-home/viola-live-{UTC stamp}/home` (0700) and a 0700
     `priv/`; `df -h /tmp` read first; one ledger row (`live-ledger.py`, kind `start`, `starts: 6` live) before the
     spawn; then `target/debug/viola --home <home> verify --record <priv>/rec -- <claude>` from the repository root
     (trusted; Run B's dir lives under it), killed at 900 s. Rehearsal: the fake agent copied as `<priv>/bin/claude`,
     with verify's fake flags as the harness passes them. Reads the stdout's last line `stamped <ver>  N pass  M fail`
     and whether `<priv>/rec/<ver>/` was written. Writes the home's path relative to the root into
     `evidence/round-state.json` for the later subcommands.
   - `rehearse-wrapped` · `live-wrapped` — on the home `live-verify` stamped, `config.json` `{"v":1,"dialog_hold_s":
     3600}` (0600; rehearsal 60); the cwd per the `keys:` line (`trust yes`: `target/e2e-home/viola-live-{stamp}/proj/`,
     its own `git init`, the folder-trust dialog passed by at most 2 down-arrows and 1 Enter typed into the rig's own pty
     only while the drained bytes hold the compiled trust literal; `trust no`: an in-tree 0700
     `target/live-round-cwd-{stamp}/`, no key, a modal killed with no key and the start spent red). One ledger row
     (`starts: 1`), then `live-pty.py`-hosted `target/debug/viola --home <home> run round -- <claude>`, then in order:
     (a) the start readings (step 5's `start`); (b) the name refusals — a second `viola run round` reads exit 1
     `already-live`; the wrapper SIGSTOPped until its heartbeat is 6 s old, a third `viola run round` reads exit 1
     `stale-heartbeat`, SIGCONT, heartbeat live again; neither spawns a child; (c) the wrapped status-line reading
     (step 5's `statusline`); (d) only on `input-box yes`: one `x` (0x78) and one DEL (0x7f) typed into the pty's input
     box, read back as the `x` in the drained bytes within 2 s and a `wheel` line holder `human`, then
     `viola --home <home> release round` and a `wheel` line holder `driver`; (e) the hold — `evidence/hold-journal.md`
     written FIRST (the home and instance, the send's UTC time, the expected expiry, and what a resumed window re-reads:
     this journal, the gate log, `events.ndjson`, `round-state.json`), then `viola --home <home> send round --file
     <priv>/prompt.txt` (a fixed synthetic prompt asking for one `AskUserQuestion` with two options), the `question`
     line awaited ≤ 300 s, then nothing typed until `dialog-expired` (≤ 3 660 s; rehearsal ≤ 120 s); (f) the
     killed-wrapper leg — SIGKILL of the wrapper after its pid and start time match, the child gone by pid and start
     time within 10 s; (g) the census, processes left 0. Rehearsal: the fake agent with a committed fake script raising
     one question (`fixtures/fake-scripts/`, read-only use; a missing one is a step-3 finding, not hand-written here).
   - `rehearse-unwrapped` · `live-unwrapped` — one ledger row (`starts: 1`), the CLI hosted by `live-pty.py` UNWRAPPED in
     the same cwd form, step 5's `statusline` reading, a Ctrl-C stop.

4. **`live-tap.py`** (step 1's copy) gains two subcommands beside its own: `rehearse` — the committed
   `fixtures/claude/2.1.302/Mcp.tools-list-1.json`'s client frames piped into `viola-mcp-tap record` in front of
   `target/debug/viola --home <rehearsal home> mcp`, then `viola-mcp-tap fixture` into `<priv>`, its tool names and
   key/type shape compared with the committed file (no `claude` spawned); `live` — its own `start` in the stdin form
   (`claude -p --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config <priv>/mcp.json`, nothing after the config path, `starts: 1`, ledgered
   first, stderr filed privately as byte count and hash prefix), then `fixture` into `<priv>/Mcp.tools-list-1.json`.

5. **`live-read.py`** (new reader, same dir) — subcommands `words` (the four lines, `words: 4 forks · {k} answered`),
   `start` (`events.ndjson` lines 1–2 `wheel{cause:start}` → `session-start`, no `budget-gate` kind; the run log's
   `process-start{subject:"claude-child"}` `cli_verified:true`, `pty_backend:"openpty"`, names only in its strip
   fields; the snapshot `cli_verified:true`; the socket dir 0700 and socket 0600; the pinned copy under
   `<home>/bin/` and `plugin/<key>/` written at this start; the child's `/proc/<pid>/fd` by class, fds 0–2 on the pty,
   no viola socket, no file under the home; the drained bytes holding neither `unable: ` nor `hint: ` — viola's only
   terminal literals, scanned in memory by `live-hold.py`, the count only written), `statusline` (the child's
   `/proc/<pid>/cmdline` flag names holding no `--settings`; no `settings.json` in the instance dir; the user's
   `~/.claude/settings.json` `statusLine.command` read only, its tokens' hash prefix compared with every descendant's
   argv polled every 20 ms for 30 s — hit count per side; its mtime and sha256 equal before and after the round),
   `box` (a recorded `Screen.ready.json` / `Screen.turn.json` with no footer-literal row and its box rule and prompt
   rows kept: `box-only: yes|no` per phase), `census`, `ledger` (starts used, reds, unread). Every reading is appended
   to `live-sessions.ndjson` through `live-ledger.py` and summarised in `evidence/live-round.md` (codes, counts,
   booleans, durations; UTC times from the clock).

6. **The rehearsals** (gate entries 4–7), on a `fake-agent` build; each rehearsal home under
   `target/e2e-home/viola-live-rehearsal-*`, removed by the rig at its end only when it made it. Record each closing
   line in `evidence/rehearsal.md`. A rehearsal that cannot go green is a finding folded into THIS chunk
   (`inputs#I1` item 8), never a reason to skip to a live step.

7. **The plain build, then STOP** (gate entry 8): `cargo build --bin viola` and `viola-mcp-tap`, no `fake-agent`
   (`target/debug/viola` is a hard link cargo re-points per feature set; verification-harness.md 2026-10-20), its
   sha256 prefix read by each live subcommand right before its spawn. /implement stops here and reports; entries 9–12
   are fired only by the operator, one at a time, each on its own word, in the order 9 → 10 → 11 → 12 (10 and 11 need
   9's green stamp; 12 needs none). A red live step is recorded and never re-fired.

8. **After the live steps** (entry 13) — `live-read.py place`: only when `cli:` is `2.1.302` (otherwise each file is
   recorded and carried, nothing placed): the re-recorded `Mcp.tools-list-1.json` copied over
   `fixtures/claude/2.1.302/Mcp.tools-list-1.json`, and a recorded `Screen.ready.json` or `Screen.turn.json` that
   `box` read `box-only: yes` copied over its 2.1.302 namesake. Nothing hand-written (layouts S1, security S1, tests S3,
   arch S3). Then entries 14–16 read the placed files under the existing suites.

9. **The ceiling's mark** — only after the hold reading AND the `hold:` line: `stands` → the doc comment of
   `DIALOG_HOLD_MAX` (`crates/viola-core/src/lib.rs:24–26`) loses «PROVISIONAL: measured live only to about 660 s»
   for the reading's words (value unchanged, 3600); `moves-to-read` and `stays-provisional` → no file changes here
   (Implementation notes).

- `.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-15-live-round-on-the-trimmed-product/evidence/` — the rigs (`live-pty.py`,
  `live-ledger.py`, `live-tap.py`, `live-hold.py`, `live-read.py`), `founder-words.md`, `rigs.md`, `rehearsal.md`,
  `round-state.json`, `hold-journal.md`, `live-sessions.ndjson`, `live-round.md`
- `fixtures/claude/2.1.302/Mcp.tools-list-1.json` — re-recorded (step 8), only on `cli: 2.1.302`
- `fixtures/claude/2.1.302/Screen.ready.json` or `Screen.turn.json` — replaced by a recorded box-only screen (step 8), only on `cli: 2.1.302` and `box-only: yes`
- `crates/viola-core/src/lib.rs` — `DIALOG_HOLD_MAX`'s doc comment (step 9), only on `hold: stands`

Entries 1–8 run in /implement's first pass; 9–12 are the live round, each an operator entry fired on its own word
(`inputs#I1` item 3); 13–20 run after the round. No `smoke` entry: the chunk touches no boot path (it changes no

  `dialog-answered{deadline_hit:true}` with its `duration_ms`, and no human key during the hold

  screen placed and entries 14 and 16 green; otherwise recorded as read and carried.

  wrapped child's argv with no `--settings`, no instance `settings.json`, and `~/.claude/settings.json`'s mtime and

  user-level settings allow `Bash(*)`, so a shell command raises no PermissionRequest; an `AskUserQuestion` raises the
  PreToolUse `question` dialog.

Entries 1–8 run in /implement's first pass; 9–12 are the live round, each an operator entry fired on its own word
(`inputs#I1` item 3); 13–20 run after the round. No `smoke` entry: the chunk touches no boot path (it changes no
product source before the round), and a `round`/`live` leg is not used — every live start is an `operator` entry by the
directive. No mutation run (`inputs#I1` item 6). No guard test is added, so no `gate.py control` is owed.
The rigs are instruments this chunk builds, and entries 2, 4–7 and 13 assert their own closing lines (step 3's
`{subcommand}: green|red|unread — …`, step 5's `words: 4 forks · …`). Their must-pass and must-fail readings are
/implement's one-shot run before entry 2's first graded use, the readings written to `evidence/rehearsal.md`:
`live-read.py words` over the four-line file reads `words: 4 forks · 0 answered` and over a three-line copy exits 3;
`live-read.py start` over a planted `events.ndjson` whose line 2 is a `budget-gate` kind reads red, and over the
rehearsal's own lines green; `live-read.py box` over the committed `fixtures/claude/2.1.302/Screen.ready.json` (a
footer-literal row) reads `box-only: no`, and over a scratch copy cut to the box's rule and prompt rows reads
`box-only: yes`; each `live-*` subcommand of `live-hold.py` and `live-tap.py` run with `founder-words.md` at `unanswered` exits 3
and starts nothing (the `rehearse*` subcommands read no founder line).
Entries 9–12 are first fired only after those readings stand.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The one writer of the start ledger (plan.md steps 1, 2, 13 and 15).

It appends one row to `live-sessions.ndjson`: the row is read from a JSON file, parsed and re-serialised, so a
mangled row fails here and never lands, and `written_at` is the UTC time read from the clock at the write, never a
time typed by hand. A `start` row is written before its start is made.

  live-ledger.py <ledger> <row file>

Run from the repository root.
"""
import datetime
import json
import sys


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    ledger, row_file = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    with open(row_file, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        row = json.load(f)
    if not isinstance(row, dict) or not isinstance(row.get("kind"), str):
        sys.exit("a row is an object with a kind")
    row["written_at"] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    line = json.dumps(row, sort_keys=False)
    with open(ledger, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")
    print(line)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

title: evidence/live-pty.py
body:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The headless host of a session (plan.md steps 1, 2 and 13; inputs#I4).

It opens a plain pty itself, sets its size to 210 columns by 45 rows, starts the given command on it as the
session leader, and drains the master. The bytes are counted and discarded: no screen is kept. Nothing is
written to the master while the session runs. No compositor, no window, no key of a desktop.

The stop is the form the harness's supervise uses (crates/viola-e2e/src/harness/supervise.rs, `stop`): Ctrl-C
written to the pty, again every 500 ms, until the child exits. It begins when `<private dir>/<label>.stop`
appears or the host gets TERM / INT. A child still alive 10 s into the stop is killed and the status says so.

The command's environment is declared, not inherited: HOME, USER, LOGNAME, SHELL, PATH, LANG, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and
TERM=xterm-256color. No CLAUDE* and no VIOLA* name crosses.

  live-pty.py <private dir> <label> -- <command> [args...]

Status: `<private dir>/<label>.pty.json`, written at the start and again at the end (codes and counts only).
Run from the repository root.
"""
import datetime
import errno
import json
import os
import select
import signal
import sys
import termios
import time

COLS, ROWS = 210, 45
CTRL_C_EVERY = 0.5
STOP_BOUND = 10.0
KEPT = ("HOME", "USER", "LOGNAME", "SHELL", "PATH", "LANG", "XDG_RUNTIME_DIR")


def stamp():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f")[:-3] + "Z"


def declared_env():
    env = {k: os.environ[k] for k in KEPT if k in os.environ}
    env["TERM"] = "xterm-256color"
    return env


def write_status(path, doc):
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(doc, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    os.replace(tmp, path)


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 5 or sys.argv[3] != "--":
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    priv, label, cmd = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[4:]
    if not os.path.isdir(priv):
        sys.exit("no private directory")
    status = os.path.join(priv, label + ".pty.json")
    stop_file = os.path.join(priv, label + ".stop")
    if os.path.exists(stop_file):
        sys.exit("a stop request for this label already stands")

    master, slave = os.openpty()
    termios.tcsetwinsize(master, (ROWS, COLS))
    env = declared_env()
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.close(master)
        os.login_tty(slave)
        try:
            os.execvpe(cmd[0], cmd, env)
        finally:
            os._exit(127)
    os.close(slave)

    doc = {
        "label": label,
        "host_pid": os.getpid(),
        "child_pid": pid,
        "cols": COLS,
        "rows": ROWS,
        "env_names": sorted(env),
        "started_at": stamp(),
        "state": "running",
    }
    write_status(status, doc)

    asked = {"signal": None}

    def on_signal(signum, _frame):
        asked["signal"] = signal.Signals(signum).name

    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, on_signal)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, on_signal)

    drained = 0
    presses = 0
    stop_began = None
    last_press = 0.0
    killed = False
    exit_status = None
    while True:
        try:
            ready, _, _ = select.select([master], [], [], 0.1)
        except InterruptedError:
            ready = []
        if ready:
            try:
                chunk = os.read(master, 65536)
            except OSError as e:
                if e.errno != errno.EIO:
                    raise
                chunk = b""
            drained += len(chunk)
        done, st = os.waitpid(pid, os.WNOHANG)
        if done:
            exit_status = st
            break
        now = time.monotonic()
        if stop_began is None and (asked["signal"] or os.path.exists(stop_file)):
            stop_began = now
            doc["stop_cause"] = asked["signal"] or "stop-file"
            doc["stop_began_at"] = stamp()
        if stop_began is not None:
            if now - stop_began > STOP_BOUND and not killed:
                killed = True
                try:
                    os.killpg(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                except ProcessLookupError:
                    pass
            elif not killed and now - last_press >= CTRL_C_EVERY:
                try:
                    os.write(master, b"\x03")
                    presses += 1
                except OSError:
                    pass
                last_press = now

    # what the child's group still wrote after its leader was reaped
    while True:
        ready, _, _ = select.select([master], [], [], 0.2)
        if not ready:
            break
        try:
            chunk = os.read(master, 65536)
        except OSError:
            break
        if not chunk:
            break
        drained += len(chunk)
    os.close(master)

    doc.update(
        {
            "state": "ended",
            "ended_at": stamp(),
            "drained_bytes": drained,
            "written_before_stop": 0,
            "ctrl_c_presses": presses,
            "killed": killed,
            "exit_code": os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(exit_status),
            "stopped": stop_began is not None,
        }
    )
    write_status(status, doc)
    print(json.dumps({k: doc.get(k) for k in ("label", "state", "exit_code", "killed", "ctrl_c_presses", "drained_bytes", "stopped")}, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The live round's rig (plan.md step 18): one print-mode `claude` start whose one MCP server is
`viola-mcp-tap` in front of `viola mcp`.

  live-tap.py setup            make the rig; print its stamp
  live-tap.py start <stamp> <form>   one start (ledgered before it, by live-ledger.py); form 1 ran
                                     start 1, form 2 is the stdin form a second start would take
  live-tap.py read <stamp>     the capture's codes and counts
  live-tap.py rehearse         the committed client frames through the tap, no claude spawned
  live-tap.py live             setup, one ledgered stdin-form start, read and fixture: ONE closing line;
                               refused (exit 3) while founder-words.md leaves cap or cli unanswered

Run from the repository root. Every child is a direct spawn under a declared environment of eight
names (no `CLAUDE*`, no `VIOLA*`), the stamped CLI's install dir first on `PATH`. Nothing it prints
holds a path, the prompt, an assistant text or a session id: codes, counts, times and hash prefixes.
"""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

CLI_VERSION = next((l.split(":", 1)[1].strip() for l in (pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
                    / "founder-words.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if l.startswith("cli:")),
                   "unanswered")
PROMPT = "reply with the single word ok"
START_BOUND_S = 300


def home():
    return pathlib.Path(os.path.expanduser("~"))


def cli_dir():
    return home() / ".local/share/mise/installs/claude" / CLI_VERSION


def declared_env():
    keep = {k: os.environ[k] for k in ("HOME", "LANG", "LOGNAME", "SHELL", "USER", "XDG_RUNTIME_DIR")
            if k in os.environ}
    keep["PATH"] = f"{cli_dir()}:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
    keep["TERM"] = "xterm-256color"
    return keep


def dirs(stamp):
    root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
    base = root / "target/e2e-home" / f"viola-live-tap-{stamp}"
    priv = root / "target" / f"mcp-live-tap-{stamp}" / "priv"
    return root, base, priv


def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")[:-4] + "Z"


def sha8(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()[:16]


def setup():
    stamp = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    root, base, priv = dirs(stamp)
    for d in (base, base / "proj", priv):
        d.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        os.chmod(d, 0o700)
    env = declared_env()
    git = subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/git", "init", "-q"], cwd=base / "proj", env=env)
    top = subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"], cwd=base / "proj",
                         env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
    own_top = pathlib.Path(top.stdout.strip()).resolve() == (base / "proj").resolve()
    outside = not (base / "proj").resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve())
    memory = [str(p.relative_to(p.anchor)) for a in [(base / "proj").resolve(), *(base / "proj").resolve().parents]
              for p in (a / "CLAUDE.md", a / ".claude/CLAUDE.md", a / "CLAUDE.local.md") if p.exists()]
    config = {"mcpServers": {"viola": {
        "type": "stdio",
        "command": str(root / "target/debug/viola-mcp-tap"),
        "args": ["record", str(priv / "capture.ndjson"), str(root / "target/debug/viola"),
                 "--home", str(base / "vhome"), "mcp"],
        "env": {},
    }}}
    fd = os.open(priv / "mcp.json", os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
        json.dump(config, f)
    version = subprocess.run([str(cli_dir() / "claude"), "--version"], env=env, capture_output=True,
                             text=True, timeout=60)
    print(json.dumps({
        "stamp": stamp, "git_init": git.returncode, "toplevel_is_proj": own_top,
        "proj_outside_work_tree": outside, "ancestor_memory_files": len(memory),
        "home_exists": (base / "vhome").exists(), "mcp_json_mode": oct(os.stat(priv / "mcp.json").st_mode & 0o777),
        "cli_version": version.stdout.strip(), "env_names": sorted(env),
        "viola_sha": sha8(root / "target/debug/viola"), "tap_sha": sha8(root / "target/debug/viola-mcp-tap"),
        "prompt_sha": hashlib.sha256(PROMPT.encode()).hexdigest()[:16],
    }))


def start(stamp, form):
    """`form` 1 is start 1's argv (the prompt after `--mcp-config`, which 2.1.302 reads as
    variadic `<configs...>`); `form` 2 gives the prompt on stdin and nothing after the config."""
    root, base, priv = dirs(stamp)
    env = declared_env()
    argv = [str(cli_dir() / "claude"), "-p", "--strict-mcp-config", "--mcp-config", str(priv / "mcp.json")]
    stdin = subprocess.DEVNULL
    if form == "1":
        argv.append(PROMPT)
    began = now()
    try:
        done = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=base / "proj", env=env,
                              input=PROMPT.encode() if form == "2" else None,
                              stdin=None if form == "2" else stdin,
                              capture_output=True, timeout=START_BOUND_S)
        code, timed_out = done.returncode, False
        out, err = done.stdout, done.stderr
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
        code, timed_out, out, err = None, True, e.stdout or b"", e.stderr or b""
    ended = now()
    fd = os.open(priv / f"stderr-{form}.txt", os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as f:
        f.write(err)
    reply = out.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()
    print(json.dumps({"form": form, "began": began, "ended": ended, "exit": code, "timed_out": timed_out,
                      "stdout_bytes": len(out), "stderr_bytes": len(err),
                      "stderr_sha": hashlib.sha256(err).hexdigest()[:16],
                      "reply_is_the_word": reply.lower().rstrip(".") == "ok"}))


def read(stamp):
    _, base, priv = dirs(stamp)
    cap = priv / "capture.ndjson"
    lines = cap.read_text().splitlines() if cap.exists() else []
    rows = [json.loads(l) for l in lines]
    seq = []
    for r in rows:
        try:
            frame = json.loads(r["line"])
        except (ValueError, KeyError):
            seq.append((r.get("dir"), "unparsed"))
            continue
        word = frame.get("method") or ("response" if "result" in frame else "error" if "error" in frame else "?")
        seq.append((r.get("dir"), word))
    print(json.dumps({
        "capture_exists": cap.exists(),
        "capture_mode": oct(cap.stat().st_mode & 0o777) if cap.exists() else None,
        "lines": len(lines),
        "by_dir": {d: sum(1 for x, _ in seq if x == d) for d in ("client", "server")},
        "sequence": seq,
        "mcp_log_lines": len((base / "vhome/diagnostics/mcp.ndjson").read_text().splitlines())
        if (base / "vhome/diagnostics/mcp.ndjson").exists() else 0,
    }))


def reader():
    import importlib.util
    sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("live_read", pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "live-read.py")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def shape(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: shape(v) for k, v in sorted(value.items())}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [shape(v) for v in value]
    return type(value).__name__


def tool_names(doc):
    return [t.get("name") for t in ((doc.get("results") or {}).get("tools/list") or {}).get("tools", [])]


def rehearse():
    """The committed exchange's client frames fed to `viola-mcp-tap record` in front of `viola mcp`, then
    `fixture`, compared by tool names and key/type shape with the committed file; no `claude` spawned."""
    import select
    import shutil
    root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
    stamp = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    base = root / "target/e2e-home" / f"viola-live-rehearsal-tap-{stamp}"
    try:
        for d in (base, base / "priv"):
            d.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=False, exist_ok=False)
            os.chmod(d, 0o700)
        priv = base / "priv"
        committed = json.loads((root / "fixtures/claude/2.1.302/Mcp.tools-list-1.json").read_text())
        env = {k: os.environ[k] for k in ("HOME", "LANG", "LOGNAME", "SHELL", "USER", "XDG_RUNTIME_DIR")
               if k in os.environ}
        env["PATH"] = "/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
        cap = priv / "capture.ndjson"
        tap = root / "target/debug/viola-mcp-tap"
        proc = subprocess.Popen([str(tap), "record", str(cap), str(root / "target/debug/viola"), "--home",
                                 str(base / "vhome"), "mcp"], cwd=root, env=env, stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        replies, buf = 0, b""
        try:
            proc.stdin.write("".join(json.dumps(c) + "\n" for c in committed["client"]).encode())
            proc.stdin.flush()
            end = datetime.datetime.now().timestamp() + 60
            while replies < len(committed["client"]) and datetime.datetime.now().timestamp() < end:
                ready, _, _ = select.select([proc.stdout], [], [], 0.2)
                if ready:
                    chunk = os.read(proc.stdout.fileno(), 65536)
                    if not chunk:
                        break
                    buf += chunk
                    replies = buf.count(b"\n")
            proc.stdin.close()
            code = proc.wait(timeout=30)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            proc.kill()
            code = None
        out = priv / "Mcp.tools-list-1.json"
        fx = subprocess.run([str(tap), "fixture", str(cap), str(out)], cwd=root, env=env, capture_output=True,
                            timeout=60)
        made = json.loads(out.read_text()) if out.exists() else {}
        codes = {
            "replies": replies, "tap_exit": code, "fixture_exit": fx.returncode,
            "tools": ",".join(str(n) for n in tool_names(made)),
            "tools_same": tool_names(made) == tool_names(committed) and bool(tool_names(made)),
            "shape_same": shape(made.get("results")) == shape(committed["results"]),
            "client_same": made.get("client") == committed["client"],
            "claude_spawned": 0,
        }
        green = (fx.returncode == 0 and codes["tools_same"] and codes["shape_same"] and codes["client_same"])
        print(("rehearse: green — " if green else "rehearse: red — ")
              + " · ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in codes.items()))
        return 0 if green else 1
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(base, ignore_errors=True)


def live():
    """One live start in the stdin form (ledgered first), then `fixture` into the private dir; refused with
    nothing made when founder-words.md leaves `cap` or `cli` unanswered or the cap would be passed."""
    import contextlib
    import io
    read_mod = reader()
    try:
        read_mod.require(read_mod.parse_words(), ("cap", "cli"), 1)
    except read_mod.Refused as e:
        print(f"refused: {e}")
        return 3
    root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()) as made:
        setup()
    rig = json.loads(made.getvalue())
    stamp = rig["stamp"]
    _, _, priv = dirs(stamp)
    row = priv / "row-start.json"
    fd = os.open(row, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
        json.dump({"kind": "start", "step": "live-tap", "starts": 1, "live": True, "cli": CLI_VERSION}, f)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "live-ledger.py"),
                    str(read_mod.LEDGER), str(row)], cwd=root, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, timeout=30, check=True)
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()) as ran:
        start(stamp, "2")
    started = json.loads(ran.getvalue())
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()) as got:
        read(stamp)
    capture = json.loads(got.getvalue())
    out = priv / "Mcp.tools-list-1.json"
    fx = subprocess.run([str(root / "target/debug/viola-mcp-tap"), "fixture", str(priv / "capture.ndjson"),
                         str(out)], cwd=root, env=declared_env(), capture_output=True, timeout=60)
    doc = json.loads(out.read_text()) if out.exists() else {}
    codes = {
        "cli_version": rig["cli_version"].split()[0] if rig["cli_version"] else None,
        "exit": started["exit"], "timed_out": started["timed_out"], "reply_is_the_word": started["reply_is_the_word"],
        "stderr_bytes": started["stderr_bytes"], "stderr_sha": started["stderr_sha"],
        "capture_lines": capture["lines"], "fixture_exit": fx.returncode, "tools": ",".join(map(str, tool_names(doc))),
        "budget_words": "usage budget" in json.dumps(doc),
    }
    green = (started["exit"] == 0 and fx.returncode == 0 and bool(tool_names(doc)) and not codes["budget_words"]
             and codes["cli_version"] == CLI_VERSION)
    reading = priv / "row-reading.json"
    fd = os.open(reading, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
        json.dump({"kind": "reading", "mode": "live", "step": "live-tap",
                   "verdict": "green" if green else "red", **codes}, f)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "live-ledger.py"),
                    str(read_mod.LEDGER), str(reading)], cwd=root, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, timeout=30, check=True)
    state_path = read_mod.STATE
    state = read_mod.read_json(state_path) or {}
    state["tap_fixture"] = str(out.relative_to(root)) if out.exists() else None
    state_path.write_text(json.dumps(state, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(("live: green — " if green else "live: red — ") + " · ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in codes.items()))
    return 0 if green else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    verb = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""
    if verb == "rehearse" and len(sys.argv) == 2:
        sys.exit(rehearse())
    if verb == "live" and len(sys.argv) == 2:
        sys.exit(live())
    if verb == "setup":
        setup()
    elif verb == "start" and len(sys.argv) == 4 and sys.argv[3] in ("1", "2"):
        start(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
    elif verb == "read" and len(sys.argv) == 3:
        read(sys.argv[2])
    else:
        sys.exit(__doc__)

build every live subcommand reads by hash before its spawn.

## The one-shot must-pass / must-fail readings (before entry 2's first graded use)

  `live-hold.py live-verify` · `live-wrapped` · `live-unwrapped` and `live-tap.py live` → `refused: word cap unanswered`,
  exit 3 each; `target/e2e-home/` listing unchanged, no `target/mcp-live-tap-*` or `target/live-round-cwd-*` made, no
  `live-sessions.ndjson` written (it did not exist before them).

Firing 1 below. The block 1–8 was fired twice, both `green 8 · red 0`: firing 2 re-ran it after `live-read.py`'s
`ledger` branch was narrowed to live rows (no function the rehearsals load changed). Firing 2's lines are byte-equal

v1-27) and a dialog hold read near its 3600 s ceiling (matrix v2-02), and it takes the three CARRYs' live readings —
the MCP `list` exchange re-recorded through `viola-mcp-tap`, a box-only screen read from a clean
`viola verify --record`, and a wrapped session's status line read beside an unwrapped one's. The round runs on
`claude` 2.1.325, the founder's word (inputs#I5): its two recordings land in no fixture dir — they stay the chunk's
evidence, and a CARRY mints the new fixture-set entry at the wrap (inputs#I6). It changes no product
behaviour: every rig reads the product from outside (its CLI, its files, `/proc`), per
(architecture · decision/real-cli-probe-local-only) and (test-plan · decision/live-readings-not-a-test-layer).

The round is built so that /implement makes the rigs and rehearses each one under the FAKE agent first, then STOPS at
the first live step (`inputs#I1` item 4). Every live step is a NAMED operator entry (`leg = 'operator'`) carrying its
live-start count, fired only on the operator's word for it. Four things are the founder's own words, written to the run
dir's `founder-forks.md` and never answered here (`inputs#I1` item 2): the live-start cap, the keys a rig may type into
its own pty, which CLI the round runs, and the 3600 s ceiling's PROVISIONAL mark. Each fills ONE line of
`{work_dir}/evidence/founder-words.md`, which every live rig reads before it starts anything: a fork answered by one
line, no re-plan. Forks 1, 2, 3 and 5 are answered (inputs#I5): `cap: 9 starts` · `keys: trust yes · input-box yes ·
statusline-read yes` · `cli: 2.1.325`; fork 4 (`hold:`) waits on entry 10's reading. Fork 3 took the arm that places
no file, which is what this revision carries.

4. **`live-tap.py`** (step 1's copy) gains two subcommands beside its own: `rehearse` — the committed
   `fixtures/claude/2.1.302/Mcp.tools-list-1.json`'s client frames piped into `viola-mcp-tap record` in front of
   `target/debug/viola --home <rehearsal home> mcp`, then `viola-mcp-tap fixture` into `<priv>`, its tool names and
   key/type shape compared with the committed file (no `claude` spawned); `live` — its own `start` in the stdin form
   (`claude -p --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config <priv>/mcp.json`, nothing after the config path, `starts: 1`, ledgered
   first, stderr filed privately as byte count and hash prefix), then `fixture` into `<priv>/Mcp.tools-list-1.json`.
3a. **The `latest` check** (revision; inputs#I5's binding on fork 3, inputs#I6) — `live-read.py` gains `latest
   [<link>]`, reading mise's `latest` link (`~/.local/share/mise/installs/claude/latest` unless a link is given; at this
   revision it links `./2.1.325`, implement outcome 2026-11-15) and printing `latest: {version} · cli {cli:} · match`, or
   `refused: latest {version} is not {cli:}` with exit 3 when the version it resolves to is not the `cli:` line's (a
   missing or unreadable link reads `refused: latest unread`, exit 3). Every live subcommand — `live-hold.py live-verify`
   · `live-wrapped` · `live-unwrapped` and `live-tap.py live` — calls the same function on the real link right after its
   founder-line refusals and before it makes anything or starts anything, refuses on a non-match with that line, and
   records the resolved version as `latest` in its ledger `start` row and its closing line. The `rehearse*` subcommands
   read no `latest`.

7. **The plain build, then STOP** (gate entry 8): `cargo build --bin viola` and `viola-mcp-tap`, no `fake-agent`
   (`target/debug/viola` is a hard link cargo re-points per feature set; verification-harness.md 2026-10-20), its
   sha256 prefix read by each live subcommand right before its spawn. /implement stops here and reports; entries 9–12
   are fired only by the operator, one at a time, each on its own word, in the order 9 → 10 → 11 → 12 (10 and 11 need
   9's green stamp; 12 needs none). A red live step is recorded and never re-fired.
   Revision: steps 1–7 stand done (run `2026-11-15T07-52-35-implement`); /implement re-enters at step 3a, takes the
   `latest` readings (Test Commands prose), re-fires entries 1–8 (the rigs changed) and stops here again.

8. **After the live steps** (entry 13) — `live-read.py place`, which places only on `cli: 2.1.302`; on the founder's
   `cli: 2.1.325` it places nothing and prints `cli_places: false` with every recording `carried`. The 2.1.325
   recordings — `Mcp.tools-list-1.json` from entry 12 and the `Screen.*.json` of entry 9's `--record` — stay in the

   fixture-set entry at the wrap (inputs#I6). Nothing hand-written (layouts S1, security S1, tests S3, arch S3). Then

(`inputs#I1` item 3); 13–20 run after the round. No `smoke` entry: the chunk touches no boot path (it changes no
product source before the round), and a `round`/`live` leg is not used — every live start is an `operator` entry by the

body:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The live round's rig (plan.md step 18): one print-mode `claude` start whose one MCP server is
`viola-mcp-tap` in front of `viola mcp`.

  live-tap.py setup            make the rig; print its stamp
  live-tap.py start <stamp> <form>   one start (ledgered before it, by live-ledger.py); form 1 ran
                                     start 1, form 2 is the stdin form a second start would take
  live-tap.py read <stamp>     the capture's codes and counts
  live-tap.py rehearse         the committed client frames through the tap, no claude spawned
  live-tap.py live             setup, one ledgered stdin-form start, read and fixture: ONE closing line;
                               refused (exit 3) while founder-words.md leaves cap or cli unanswered

Run from the repository root. Every child is a direct spawn under a declared environment of eight
names (no `CLAUDE*`, no `VIOLA*`), the stamped CLI's install dir first on `PATH`. Nothing it prints
holds a path, the prompt, an assistant text or a session id: codes, counts, times and hash prefixes.
"""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

CLI_VERSION = next((l.split(":", 1)[1].strip() for l in (pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
                    / "founder-words.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if l.startswith("cli:")),
                   "unanswered")
PROMPT = "reply with the single word ok"
START_BOUND_S = 300


def home():
    return pathlib.Path(os.path.expanduser("~"))


def cli_dir():
    return home() / ".local/share/mise/installs/claude" / CLI_VERSION


def declared_env():
    keep = {k: os.environ[k] for k in ("HOME", "LANG", "LOGNAME", "SHELL", "USER", "XDG_RUNTIME_DIR")
            if k in os.environ}
    keep["PATH"] = f"{cli_dir()}:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
    keep["TERM"] = "xterm-256color"
    return keep


def dirs(stamp):
    root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
    base = root / "target/e2e-home" / f"viola-live-tap-{stamp}"
    priv = root / "target" / f"mcp-live-tap-{stamp}" / "priv"
    return root, base, priv


def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")[:-4] + "Z"


def sha8(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()[:16]


def setup():
    stamp = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    root, base, priv = dirs(stamp)
    for d in (base, base / "proj", priv):
        d.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        os.chmod(d, 0o700)
    env = declared_env()
    git = subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/git", "init", "-q"], cwd=base / "proj", env=env)
    top = subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"], cwd=base / "proj",
                         env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
    own_top = pathlib.Path(top.stdout.strip()).resolve() == (base / "proj").resolve()
    outside = not (base / "proj").resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve())
    memory = [str(p.relative_to(p.anchor)) for a in [(base / "proj").resolve(), *(base / "proj").resolve().parents]
              for p in (a / "CLAUDE.md", a / ".claude/CLAUDE.md", a / "CLAUDE.local.md") if p.exists()]
    config = {"mcpServers": {"viola": {
        "type": "stdio",
        "command": str(root / "target/debug/viola-mcp-tap"),
        "args": ["record", str(priv / "capture.ndjson"), str(root / "target/debug/viola"),
                 "--home", str(base / "vhome"), "mcp"],
        "env": {},
    }}}
    fd = os.open(priv / "mcp.json", os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
        json.dump(config, f)
    version = subprocess.run([str(cli_dir() / "claude"), "--version"], env=env, capture_output=True,
                             text=True, timeout=60)
    print(json.dumps({
        "stamp": stamp, "git_init": git.returncode, "toplevel_is_proj": own_top,
        "proj_outside_work_tree": outside, "ancestor_memory_files": len(memory),
        "home_exists": (base / "vhome").exists(), "mcp_json_mode": oct(os.stat(priv / "mcp.json").st_mode & 0o777),
        "cli_version": version.stdout.strip(), "env_names": sorted(env),
        "viola_sha": sha8(root / "target/debug/viola"), "tap_sha": sha8(root / "target/debug/viola-mcp-tap"),
        "prompt_sha": hashlib.sha256(PROMPT.encode()).hexdigest()[:16],
    }))


def start(stamp, form):
    """`form` 1 is start 1's argv (the prompt after `--mcp-config`, which 2.1.302 reads as
    variadic `<configs...>`); `form` 2 gives the prompt on stdin and nothing after the config."""
    root, base, priv = dirs(stamp)
    env = declared_env()
    argv = [str(cli_dir() / "claude"), "-p", "--strict-mcp-config", "--mcp-config", str(priv / "mcp.json")]
    stdin = subprocess.DEVNULL
    if form == "1":
        argv.append(PROMPT)
    began = now()
    try:
        done = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=base / "proj", env=env,
                              input=PROMPT.encode() if form == "2" else None,
                              stdin=None if form == "2" else stdin,
                              capture_output=True, timeout=START_BOUND_S)
        code, timed_out = done.returncode, False
        out, err = done.stdout, done.stderr
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
        code, timed_out, out, err = None, True, e.stdout or b"", e.stderr or b""
    ended = now()
    fd = os.open(priv / f"stderr-{form}.txt", os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as f:
        f.write(err)
    reply = out.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()
    print(json.dumps({"form": form, "began": began, "ended": ended, "exit": code, "timed_out": timed_out,
                      "stdout_bytes": len(out), "stderr_bytes": len(err),
                      "stderr_sha": hashlib.sha256(err).hexdigest()[:16],
                      "reply_is_the_word": reply.lower().rstrip(".") == "ok"}))


def read(stamp):
    _, base, priv = dirs(stamp)
    cap = priv / "capture.ndjson"
    lines = cap.read_text().splitlines() if cap.exists() else []
    rows = [json.loads(l) for l in lines]
    seq = []
    for r in rows:
        try:
            frame = json.loads(r["line"])
        except (ValueError, KeyError):
            seq.append((r.get("dir"), "unparsed"))
            continue
        word = frame.get("method") or ("response" if "result" in frame else "error" if "error" in frame else "?")
        seq.append((r.get("dir"), word))
    print(json.dumps({
        "capture_exists": cap.exists(),
        "capture_mode": oct(cap.stat().st_mode & 0o777) if cap.exists() else None,
        "lines": len(lines),
        "by_dir": {d: sum(1 for x, _ in seq if x == d) for d in ("client", "server")},
        "sequence": seq,
        "mcp_log_lines": len((base / "vhome/diagnostics/mcp.ndjson").read_text().splitlines())
        if (base / "vhome/diagnostics/mcp.ndjson").exists() else 0,
    }))


def reader():
    import importlib.util
    sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("live_read", pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "live-read.py")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def shape(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: shape(v) for k, v in sorted(value.items())}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [shape(v) for v in value]
    return type(value).__name__


def tool_names(doc):
    return [t.get("name") for t in ((doc.get("results") or {}).get("tools/list") or {}).get("tools", [])]


def rehearse():
    """The committed exchange's client frames fed to `viola-mcp-tap record` in front of `viola mcp`, then
    `fixture`, compared by tool names and key/type shape with the committed file; no `claude` spawned."""
    import select
    import shutil
    root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
    stamp = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    base = root / "target/e2e-home" / f"viola-live-rehearsal-tap-{stamp}"
    try:
        for d in (base, base / "priv"):
            d.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=False, exist_ok=False)
            os.chmod(d, 0o700)
        priv = base / "priv"
        committed = json.loads((root / "fixtures/claude/2.1.302/Mcp.tools-list-1.json").read_text())
        env = {k: os.environ[k] for k in ("HOME", "LANG", "LOGNAME", "SHELL", "USER", "XDG_RUNTIME_DIR")
               if k in os.environ}
        env["PATH"] = "/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
        cap = priv / "capture.ndjson"
        tap = root / "target/debug/viola-mcp-tap"
        proc = subprocess.Popen([str(tap), "record", str(cap), str(root / "target/debug/viola"), "--home",
                                 str(base / "vhome"), "mcp"], cwd=root, env=env, stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        replies, buf = 0, b""
        try:
            proc.stdin.write("".join(json.dumps(c) + "\n" for c in committed["client"]).encode())
            proc.stdin.flush()
            end = datetime.datetime.now().timestamp() + 60
            while replies < len(committed["client"]) and datetime.datetime.now().timestamp() < end:
                ready, _, _ = select.select([proc.stdout], [], [], 0.2)
                if ready:
                    chunk = os.read(proc.stdout.fileno(), 65536)
                    if not chunk:
                        break
                    buf += chunk
                    replies = buf.count(b"\n")
            proc.stdin.close()
            code = proc.wait(timeout=30)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            proc.kill()
            code = None
        out = priv / "Mcp.tools-list-1.json"
        fx = subprocess.run([str(tap), "fixture", str(cap), str(out)], cwd=root, env=env, capture_output=True,
                            timeout=60)
        made = json.loads(out.read_text()) if out.exists() else {}
        codes = {
            "replies": replies, "tap_exit": code, "fixture_exit": fx.returncode,
            "tools": ",".join(str(n) for n in tool_names(made)),
            "tools_same": tool_names(made) == tool_names(committed) and bool(tool_names(made)),
            "shape_same": shape(made.get("results")) == shape(committed["results"]),
            "client_same": made.get("client") == committed["client"],
            "claude_spawned": 0,
        }
        green = (fx.returncode == 0 and codes["tools_same"] and codes["shape_same"] and codes["client_same"])
        print(("rehearse: green — " if green else "rehearse: red — ")
              + " · ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in codes.items()))
        return 0 if green else 1
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(base, ignore_errors=True)


def live():
    """One live start in the stdin form (ledgered first), then `fixture` into the private dir; refused with
    nothing made when founder-words.md leaves `cap` or `cli` unanswered or the cap would be passed."""
    import contextlib
    import io
    read_mod = reader()
    try:
        read_mod.require(read_mod.parse_words(), ("cap", "cli"), 1)
        resolved = read_mod.latest(CLI_VERSION)
    except read_mod.Refused as e:
        print(f"refused: {e}")
        return 3
    root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()) as made:
        setup()
    rig = json.loads(made.getvalue())
    stamp = rig["stamp"]
    _, _, priv = dirs(stamp)
    row = priv / "row-start.json"
    fd = os.open(row, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
        json.dump({"kind": "start", "step": "live-tap", "starts": 1, "live": True, "cli": CLI_VERSION,
                   "latest": resolved}, f)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "live-ledger.py"),
                    str(read_mod.LEDGER), str(row)], cwd=root, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, timeout=30, check=True)
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()) as ran:
        start(stamp, "2")
    started = json.loads(ran.getvalue())
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()) as got:
        read(stamp)
    capture = json.loads(got.getvalue())
    out = priv / "Mcp.tools-list-1.json"
    fx = subprocess.run([str(root / "target/debug/viola-mcp-tap"), "fixture", str(priv / "capture.ndjson"),
                         str(out)], cwd=root, env=declared_env(), capture_output=True, timeout=60)
    doc = json.loads(out.read_text()) if out.exists() else {}
    codes = {
        "latest": resolved,
        "cli_version": rig["cli_version"].split()[0] if rig["cli_version"] else None,
        "exit": started["exit"], "timed_out": started["timed_out"], "reply_is_the_word": started["reply_is_the_word"],
        "stderr_bytes": started["stderr_bytes"], "stderr_sha": started["stderr_sha"],
        "capture_lines": capture["lines"], "fixture_exit": fx.returncode, "tools": ",".join(map(str, tool_names(doc))),
        "budget_words": "usage budget" in json.dumps(doc),
    }
    green = (started["exit"] == 0 and fx.returncode == 0 and bool(tool_names(doc)) and not codes["budget_words"]
             and codes["cli_version"] == CLI_VERSION)
    reading = priv / "row-reading.json"
    fd = os.open(reading, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
        json.dump({"kind": "reading", "mode": "live", "step": "live-tap",
                   "verdict": "green" if green else "red", **codes}, f)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "live-ledger.py"),
                    str(read_mod.LEDGER), str(reading)], cwd=root, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, timeout=30, check=True)
    state_path = read_mod.STATE
    state = read_mod.read_json(state_path) or {}
    state["tap_fixture"] = str(out.relative_to(root)) if out.exists() else None
    state_path.write_text(json.dumps(state, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(("live: green — " if green else "live: red — ") + " · ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in codes.items()))
    return 0 if green else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    verb = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""
    if verb == "rehearse" and len(sys.argv) == 2:
        sys.exit(rehearse())
    if verb == "live" and len(sys.argv) == 2:
        sys.exit(live())
    if verb == "setup":
        setup()
    elif verb == "start" and len(sys.argv) == 4 and sys.argv[3] in ("1", "2"):
        start(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
    elif verb == "read" and len(sys.argv) == 3:
        read(sys.argv[2])
    else:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
