- 7 `rehearse: green — replies=2 · tap_exit=0 · fixture_exit=0 · tools=send,wait,last,answer,list · tools_same=True · shape_same=True · client_same=True · claude_spawned=0`

## What the rehearsals do not reach (the fake agent's limits)
- The trust dialog's `selected` reading and its Enter: the fake draws the trust row unselected and answers no key, so
  the granted arm rehearses the bound alone (2 down-arrows = 6 key bytes, no Enter, the modal SIGKILLed with no key).
- The DEL erase: the fake keeps a DEL in its prompt (`src/bin/viola-fake-agent/input.rs` `plain()`), so the erased
  branch (release after an erased box) is not reached; the standing-`x` stop arm is, and the release is read alone
  (`release_probe`) — the rehearsal-only order of inputs#I4.
- The status-line hits: every rehearsal reads `statusline-read` as `no` (no founder line read), so
  `~/.claude/settings.json` is never opened; the hits reading is live-only.
- The echo of `x` is read from the fake's key receipt (`78`); live it is read from the drained bytes' prompt row.

## The pre-gate probes
Before the graded firing the rigs were probed by hand (fix-loop): one `rehearse-verify` probe read red
(`cli_version_matches=False` — the fake answers `--version` with its default unless given `--cli-version`; fixed) and
left its `reading` row (mode `rehearsal`, verdict `red`, 08:03:23Z) in `live-sessions.ndjson`, kept as written; three
`rehearse-wrapped` probes read a `None` snapshot pid (the snapshot is an envelope; fixed), `cli_verified:false` (the run
gate reads the fake's default 2.1.287; fixed) and `send` `not-delivered`/`no-prompt-submitted` (the fake's no-erase;
inputs#I4). No probe or rehearsal wrote a `start` row.

## Step 3a — the `latest` check (plan rev 4; run `2026-11-15T08-33-57-implement`)
Founder lines at the time: `cap: 9 starts` · `keys: trust yes · input-box yes · statusline-read yes` · `cli: 2.1.325` ·
`hold: unanswered`. mise's real link `~/.local/share/mise/installs/claude/latest` read `./2.1.325` before and after
(never moved). Scratch inputs in the session scratchpad (`$TMPDIR/claude-1000/…/scratchpad/`).
- `live-read.py latest` over the real link → `latest: 2.1.325 · cli 2.1.325 · match`, exit 0 (must-pass).
- over a scratch link pointing at `./2.1.326` → `refused: latest 2.1.326 is not 2.1.325`, exit 3 (must-fail).
- over an absent link → `refused: latest unread`, exit 3 (must-fail).
- each live subcommand, the founder lines answered, its reader's link pointed at the scratch link (`latest-refusal.py`,
  the modules loaded and `READ.LATEST` set; the CLI has no link seam):
  `live-verify: exit 3 · refused: latest 2.1.326 is not 2.1.325` · `live-wrapped: exit 3 · …` ·
  `live-unwrapped: exit 3 · …` · `live-tap live: exit 3 · …` — `target/e2e-home/` listing unchanged, no
  `target/mcp-live-tap-*` or `target/live-round-cwd-*` made, `live-sessions.ndjson` 3 lines before and after (no row).

## After entry 9 — the state-save fix and the derive (inputs#I9; run `2026-11-15T08-33-57-implement`)
- **The state-save fix** (`rel()` keeps the path as spelled, never resolving the `target/e2e-home` link;
  `save_state` takes a path). `rehearse-verify` now writes its state into its own private dir through the link and
  reads it back. Gate entry 4, firing 2 of this run:
  `rehearse-verify: green — headroom_gib=15 · cli_version_matches=True · viola_sha=f5606b4881aa2da2 · verify_exit=0 · verify_s=5 · stderr_bytes=0 · stamped=2.1.302/21/0 · recorded_files=27 · box_only_ready=no · box_only_turn=no · state_saved=True · census_held=0`
  — the block 1–8 `green 8 · red 0`, ending on the plain build `a0e247fd3a77f744`.
- **`rehearse-derive`** (one-shot, run on the fake-agent build `f5606b4881aa2da2` before that block): a rehearsal home
  behind the link, stamped by verify against the fake agent, with a scratch ledger holding a `live-verify` start row
  before the stamp and a red reading row:
  `rehearse-derive: green — stamped=True · pass_arm=written,stamp=pass,recording=refused,entry=red,home_is_dir=True,via_link=True · provenance_keys=reading_row,relied,stamps,start_row · fail_arm=refused:relied row local-command-compact reads fail · fail_arm_wrote=False · relied_count=21 · census_held=0`
  — the `0 fail` arm writes the state and reads it back; the same home with one relied row set `fail` is refused and
  writes nothing. The relied set is read from the source (`LedgerRow::relied()` = `ALL` and the `id()` arms of
  `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs`), never typed into the rig.

## Step 3b — `stamp-check`'s readings before entry 21's first graded use (plan rev 7; run `2026-11-15T09-00-58-implement`)
`stamp-check-readings.py` in the session scratchpad, each a direct spawn of `live-hold.py stamp-check <base>`;
`evidence/round-state.json` sha256 `c02a66f3ce6ee453…` before and after (no write):
- a · the kept home `target/e2e-home/viola-live-20261115T083805Z` → exit 0 ·
  `stamp-check: pass — stamped 2.1.325 · 21 of 21 relied pass · stamps sha256 86f763d8f43f5281 · start rows 5 · latest 2.1.325`
  (must-pass).
- b · a control copy of its ledger under `target/e2e-home/viola-live-control-*` with the relied row
  `local-command-compact` set `fail` → exit 1 · `stamp-check: red — relied row local-command-compact reads fail`
  (must-fail; made and removed by the script, `control copy removed: True`).
- c · an absent base `target/e2e-home/viola-live-absent-*` → exit 1 · `stamp-check: unread — kept home absent`
  (must-fail: the reboot case).
- Gate entry 21, fired twice in this run: `21 probe green · exit 0` both times.

## Before entry 10 — the screen model and the corrected box arm (inputs#I16; run `2026-11-15T09-00-58-implement`)
- `live-hold.py` gains a minimal VT screen model at 210×45 (`Screen`): printable cells, CR/LF/BS/TAB, CSI cursor
  moves, erases, inserts and deletes; SGR, modes and OSC ignored. The `x` echo and the DEL erase are read from the
  reconstructed box row (the last row opening `❯` under a box rule), no longer from the stripped stream.
- Its known readings on synthetic streams (`screen_controls()`, `True` on all four): a whole-row rewrite → echo `x`,
  then `erased`; a one-cell diff erase → echo `x`, then `erased`; a placeholder drawn after the erase → `erased`; no
  redraw after the DEL → `stands`.
- The corrected arm: a box reading `stands` no longer ends the step. The rig records `box: erased|stands`, types no
  further key either way, releases, and sends; the send is the second witness (`send-confirmed` → the box was empty;
  `not-delivered` or a `wheel` line `human` → the `x` stood, the hold lost, the step red).
- Rehearsed under the fake agent (its no-erase gives the true «stands»), gate entry 5, firing 2 of this run:
  `… · keys_refused_arm=refused-unanswered,written=0,human=False · keys=echo=True,human=True,box=stands,release=0,driver=True,keys_after_del=0 · stands_arm_send=13/x-stood · screen_model=True · …`
  with the hold `hold_s=60 · deadline_hit=True · duration_ms=60009`; the block 1–8 and 21 `green 9 · red 0`, ending on
  the plain build.

## After entry 10 — the three rig faults fixed (inputs#I19; run `2026-11-15T09-11-10-implement`)
1. **The trust step reads the screen model**: the trust literal, the `selected` read (`❯` opening the literal's row)
   and the ready screen are read from the model's rows, never from the stripped stream. A synthetic control — a
   dialog drawn with cursor-forward moves between its words, `\x1b[1C` in place of each space — reads
   `screen model holds the literal: True · selected: True` and `stripped stream holds the literal: False`.
2. **The send witness tells `input-not-ready` apart**: `detail:input-not-ready` → `unread` (no input box stood);
   another `not-delivered` or a `wheel` line `human` → `x-stood`; a confirmed send → `empty`
   (`witness_controls() == True` on those three fixed outcomes).
3. **Every live session keeps its screen**: frames of the model at each decision point (`trust-seen`,
   `trust-selected` / `-after-enter` / `-unpassed` / `-gone`, `start`, `after-x`, `after-del`, `after-send`,
   `question` / `no-question`, `expired` / `no-expiry`, `before-kill`, `final`), written by `save_screens` — live
   into `evidence/screens-{sub}[-{arm}]-{stamp}.json`, a rehearsal into its private dir — scrubbed as the recorder
   scrubs a fixture (the root → `.`, the e2e link's target → `target/e2e-home`, the home → `~`, the user word →
   `<user>`) and checked clean (no `/home/`, no `/tmp/`, no user word); also written on an exception exit.
- Rehearsed under the fake agent, the block 1–8 and 21 `green 9 · red 0` (this run's firing 2), entry 5:
  `… · screens=frames=9,clean=True · modal_arm=modal-refused-no/13/unread/frames=3,clean=True · witness_controls=True · …`
  — the modal arm is entry 10's shape: a wrapped fake in a cwd it does not trust, its modal read off the screen model,
  the trust grant `no` (no key), the send refused, the witness `unread`, the frames kept; the hold arm unchanged
  (`hold_s=60 · deadline_hit=True · duration_ms=60003`). Entry 6:
  `main_screens=frames=3,clean=True · trust-granted_trust=modal-unpassed/2/0 · trust-granted_screens=frames=3,clean=True · trust-refused_trust=modal-refused-no/0/0 · trust-refused_screens=frames=2,clean=True`.

## Step 3c — the kept screens split (plan rev 10; inputs#I22 item 4; run `2026-11-15T09-38-40-implement`)
- Frames are written only under `target/live-round-screens/` (dir 0700, files 0600, gitignored by `.gitignore`'s
  `target/`), by `save_screens` for every session and arm, the modal arm included. One closed-word line per frame is

  rehearse`. `found` is one of the five words: the trust literal, a selector dialog (`question` after a send,
  `unknown-modal` before), the input box (box-only rows or a footer literal), or `none`.
- Rehearsed, the block 1–8 `green 8 · red 0`. Entry 5 reads
  `screens=frames=9,clean=True,summary=9,closed=True · modal_arm=modal-refused-no/13/unread/frames=3,clean=True,summary=3,closed=True`
  (hold `hold_s=60 · deadline_hit=True · duration_ms=60000`). Entry 6 reads
  `main_screens=frames=3,…,closed=True · trust-granted_trust=modal-unpassed/2/0 · trust-granted_screens=frames=3,…,closed=True · trust-refused_screens=frames=2,…,closed=True`.
  Five frame files stand locally under `target/live-round-screens/`, and none under the work dir or a run dir.
- `screens-check`, the one-shot readings before entry 22's first graded use:

## Step 3e — a used home (plan rev 12; inputs#I26; run `2026-11-15T09-49-21-implement`)
- `make_cwd`'s `trust yes` arm (and every rehearsal) now makes a fresh `proj-{stamp}/` under the base (`fresh_proj`,

## Step 3f — the screen's status row, unnumbered options, the measured trust form (plan rev 14; inputs#I29; run `2026-11-15T10-00-02-implement`)

# Rehearsal — 2026-11-15-live-round-on-the-trimmed-product

Run dir `.andromeda/runs/2026-11-15T07-52-35-implement/`; gate trail `gate-2026-11-15-live-round-on-the-trimmed-product.json`.
Every rehearsal ran on the `fake-agent` build of `target/debug/viola` (sha256 prefix `f5606b4881aa2da2`); entry 8 then
re-pointed the link to the plain build (`a0e247fd3a77f744`, the `target/debug/deps/viola-b542566ddb0401f6` inode), the
build every live subcommand reads by hash before its spawn.

## The one-shot must-pass / must-fail readings (before entry 2's first graded use)
Planted inputs in the session scratchpad (`$TMPDIR/claude-1000/…/scratchpad/`, by `plant.py`).
- `live-read.py words` over `founder-words.md` → `words: 4 forks · 0 answered`, exit 0 (must-pass).
- `live-read.py words` over a three-line copy → `refused: words-malformed`, exit 3 (must-fail).
- `live-read.py start` over a planted home whose `events.ndjson` line 2 is a `budget-gate` kind → `start: red`,
  `budget_kind_lines: 1`, `first_two_wheel_then_session_start: false`, exit 1 (must-fail); over the rehearsal's own
  lines → `start=green` inside entry 5's closing line (must-pass).
- `live-read.py box fixtures/claude/2.1.302/Screen.ready.json` (a footer-literal row) → `box-only: no · ready`;
  over a scratch copy cut to the box's rule and prompt rows → `box-only: yes · ready`.
- Every `live-*` subcommand with `founder-words.md` at `unanswered`, each under `timeout 60`:
  `live-hold.py live-verify` · `live-wrapped` · `live-unwrapped` and `live-tap.py live` → `refused: word cap unanswered`,
  exit 3 each; `target/e2e-home/` listing unchanged, no `target/mcp-live-tap-*` or `target/live-round-cwd-*` made, no
  `live-sessions.ndjson` written (it did not exist before them).

## The closing lines (gate entries 4–7, verbatim from their logs)
Firing 1 below. The block 1–8 was fired twice, both `green 8 · red 0`: firing 2 re-ran it after `live-read.py`'s
`ledger` branch was narrowed to live rows (no function the rehearsals load changed). Firing 2's lines are byte-equal
to these but for entry 5's `duration_ms=60019`.
- 4 `rehearse-verify: green — headroom_gib=15 · cli_version_matches=True · viola_sha=f5606b4881aa2da2 · verify_exit=0 · verify_s=5 · stderr_bytes=0 · stamped=2.1.302/21/0 · recorded_files=27 · box_only_ready=no · box_only_turn=no · census_held=0`
- 5 `rehearse-wrapped: green — viola_sha=f5606b4881aa2da2 · trust=no-dialog · arrows=0 · enters=0 · session_start=True · start=green · start_detail={"budget_kind_lines":0,"child_cli_verified":true,"child_fds":{"fds":4,"on_endpoint":0,"std_on_pty":3,"under_home":0},"child_process_start":1,"child_pty_backend":"openpty","first_two_wheel_then_session_start":true,"hooks_run_pinned_copy":true,"plugin_written_at_start":true,"snapshot_cli_verified":true,"socket_dir_mode":"0o700","socket_mode":"0o600"} · second_run=1/already-live · third_run=1/stale-heartbeat · heartbeat_live_again=True · refusal_children=0 · statusline=green · statusline_detail={"child_argv_read":true,"hits":"unread","instance_settings_json":false,"settings_flag":false,"statusline_read":"no"} · send=0 · send_codes=none · question=True · dialog_expired=True · kinds_after_send=send-issued/prompt-submitted/send-confirmed/question/dialog-expired · hold_s=60 · deadline_hit=True · duration_ms=60016 · keys_during_hold=0 · keys_refused_arm=refused-unanswered,written=0,human=False · keys=echo=True,human=True,erase=stands · keys_stop_arm=stopped · release_probe=release=0,driver=True · erase_predicate=True · child_gone_after_kill=True · unable_bytes=0 · hint_bytes=0 · drained_bytes=91 · census_held=0`
- 6 `rehearse-unwrapped: green — viola_sha=f5606b4881aa2da2 · main_trust=no-dialog/0/0 · statusline=green · statusline_detail={"child_argv_read":true,"hits":"unread","instance_settings_json":false,"settings_flag":false,"statusline_read":"no"} · main_stop=exit-0 · trust-granted_trust=modal-unpassed/2/0 · trust-granted_agent_keys=6 · trust-granted_stop=killed · trust-refused_trust=modal-refused-no/0/0 · trust-refused_agent_keys=0 · trust-refused_stop=killed · census_held=0`
- 7 `rehearse: green — replies=2 · tap_exit=0 · fixture_exit=0 · tools=send,wait,last,answer,list · tools_same=True · shape_same=True · client_same=True · claude_spawned=0`

## What the rehearsals do not reach (the fake agent's limits)
- The trust dialog's `selected` reading and its Enter: the fake draws the trust row unselected and answers no key, so
  the granted arm rehearses the bound alone (2 down-arrows = 6 key bytes, no Enter, the modal SIGKILLed with no key).
- The DEL erase: the fake keeps a DEL in its prompt (`src/bin/viola-fake-agent/input.rs` `plain()`), so the erased
  branch (release after an erased box) is not reached; the standing-`x` stop arm is, and the release is read alone
  (`release_probe`) — the rehearsal-only order of inputs#I4.
- The status-line hits: every rehearsal reads `statusline-read` as `no` (no founder line read), so
  `~/.claude/settings.json` is never opened; the hits reading is live-only.
- The echo of `x` is read from the fake's key receipt (`78`); live it is read from the drained bytes' prompt row.

## The pre-gate probes
Before the graded firing the rigs were probed by hand (fix-loop): one `rehearse-verify` probe read red
(`cli_version_matches=False` — the fake answers `--version` with its default unless given `--cli-version`; fixed) and
left its `reading` row (mode `rehearsal`, verdict `red`, 08:03:23Z) in `live-sessions.ndjson`, kept as written; three
`rehearse-wrapped` probes read a `None` snapshot pid (the snapshot is an envelope; fixed), `cli_verified:false` (the run
gate reads the fake's default 2.1.287; fixed) and `send` `not-delivered`/`no-prompt-submitted` (the fake's no-erase;
inputs#I4). No probe or rehearsal wrote a `start` row.

## Step 3a — the `latest` check (plan rev 4; run `2026-11-15T08-33-57-implement`)
Founder lines at the time: `cap: 9 starts` · `keys: trust yes · input-box yes · statusline-read yes` · `cli: 2.1.325` ·
`hold: unanswered`. mise's real link `~/.local/share/mise/installs/claude/latest` read `./2.1.325` before and after
(never moved). Scratch inputs in the session scratchpad (`$TMPDIR/claude-1000/…/scratchpad/`).
- `live-read.py latest` over the real link → `latest: 2.1.325 · cli 2.1.325 · match`, exit 0 (must-pass).
- over a scratch link pointing at `./2.1.326` → `refused: latest 2.1.326 is not 2.1.325`, exit 3 (must-fail).
- over an absent link → `refused: latest unread`, exit 3 (must-fail).
- each live subcommand, the founder lines answered, its reader's link pointed at the scratch link (`latest-refusal.py`,
  the modules loaded and `READ.LATEST` set; the CLI has no link seam):
  `live-verify: exit 3 · refused: latest 2.1.326 is not 2.1.325` · `live-wrapped: exit 3 · …` ·
  `live-unwrapped: exit 3 · …` · `live-tap live: exit 3 · …` — `target/e2e-home/` listing unchanged, no
  `target/mcp-live-tap-*` or `target/live-round-cwd-*` made, `live-sessions.ndjson` 3 lines before and after (no row).

## After entry 9 — the state-save fix and the derive (inputs#I9; run `2026-11-15T08-33-57-implement`)
- **The state-save fix** (`rel()` keeps the path as spelled, never resolving the `target/e2e-home` link;
  `save_state` takes a path). `rehearse-verify` now writes its state into its own private dir through the link and
  reads it back. Gate entry 4, firing 2 of this run:
  `rehearse-verify: green — headroom_gib=15 · cli_version_matches=True · viola_sha=f5606b4881aa2da2 · verify_exit=0 · verify_s=5 · stderr_bytes=0 · stamped=2.1.302/21/0 · recorded_files=27 · box_only_ready=no · box_only_turn=no · state_saved=True · census_held=0`
  — the block 1–8 `green 8 · red 0`, ending on the plain build `a0e247fd3a77f744`.
- **`rehearse-derive`** (one-shot, run on the fake-agent build `f5606b4881aa2da2` before that block): a rehearsal home
  behind the link, stamped by verify against the fake agent, with a scratch ledger holding a `live-verify` start row
  before the stamp and a red reading row:
  `rehearse-derive: green — stamped=True · pass_arm=written,stamp=pass,recording=refused,entry=red,home_is_dir=True,via_link=True · provenance_keys=reading_row,relied,stamps,start_row · fail_arm=refused:relied row local-command-compact reads fail · fail_arm_wrote=False · relied_count=21 · census_held=0`
  — the `0 fail` arm writes the state and reads it back; the same home with one relied row set `fail` is refused and
  writes nothing. The relied set is read from the source (`LedgerRow::relied()` = `ALL` and the `id()` arms of
  `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs`), never typed into the rig.

## Step 3b — `stamp-check`'s readings before entry 21's first graded use (plan rev 7; run `2026-11-15T09-00-58-implement`)
`stamp-check-readings.py` in the session scratchpad, each a direct spawn of `live-hold.py stamp-check <base>`;
`evidence/round-state.json` sha256 `c02a66f3ce6ee453…` before and after (no write):
- a · the kept home `target/e2e-home/viola-live-20261115T083805Z` → exit 0 ·
  `stamp-check: pass — stamped 2.1.325 · 21 of 21 relied pass · stamps sha256 86f763d8f43f5281 · start rows 5 · latest 2.1.325`
  (must-pass).
- b · a control copy of its ledger under `target/e2e-home/viola-live-control-*` with the relied row
  `local-command-compact` set `fail` → exit 1 · `stamp-check: red — relied row local-command-compact reads fail`
  (must-fail; made and removed by the script, `control copy removed: True`).
- c · an absent base `target/e2e-home/viola-live-absent-*` → exit 1 · `stamp-check: unread — kept home absent`
  (must-fail: the reboot case).
- Gate entry 21, fired twice in this run: `21 probe green · exit 0` both times.

## Before entry 10 — the screen model and the corrected box arm (inputs#I16; run `2026-11-15T09-00-58-implement`)
- `live-hold.py` gains a minimal VT screen model at 210×45 (`Screen`): printable cells, CR/LF/BS/TAB, CSI cursor
  moves, erases, inserts and deletes; SGR, modes and OSC ignored. The `x` echo and the DEL erase are read from the
  reconstructed box row (the last row opening `❯` under a box rule), no longer from the stripped stream.
- Its known readings on synthetic streams (`screen_controls()`, `True` on all four): a whole-row rewrite → echo `x`,
  then `erased`; a one-cell diff erase → echo `x`, then `erased`; a placeholder drawn after the erase → `erased`; no
  redraw after the DEL → `stands`.
- The corrected arm: a box reading `stands` no longer ends the step. The rig records `box: erased|stands`, types no
  further key either way, releases, and sends; the send is the second witness (`send-confirmed` → the box was empty;
  `not-delivered` or a `wheel` line `human` → the `x` stood, the hold lost, the step red).
- Rehearsed under the fake agent (its no-erase gives the true «stands»), gate entry 5, firing 2 of this run:
  `… · keys_refused_arm=refused-unanswered,written=0,human=False · keys=echo=True,human=True,box=stands,release=0,driver=True,keys_after_del=0 · stands_arm_send=13/x-stood · screen_model=True · …`
  with the hold `hold_s=60 · deadline_hit=True · duration_ms=60009`; the block 1–8 and 21 `green 9 · red 0`, ending on
  the plain build.

## After entry 10 — the three rig faults fixed (inputs#I19; run `2026-11-15T09-11-10-implement`)
1. **The trust step reads the screen model**: the trust literal, the `selected` read (`❯` opening the literal's row)
   and the ready screen are read from the model's rows, never from the stripped stream. A synthetic control — a
   dialog drawn with cursor-forward moves between its words, `\x1b[1C` in place of each space — reads
   `screen model holds the literal: True · selected: True` and `stripped stream holds the literal: False`.
2. **The send witness tells `input-not-ready` apart**: `detail:input-not-ready` → `unread` (no input box stood);
   another `not-delivered` or a `wheel` line `human` → `x-stood`; a confirmed send → `empty`
   (`witness_controls() == True` on those three fixed outcomes).
3. **Every live session keeps its screen**: frames of the model at each decision point (`trust-seen`,
   `trust-selected` / `-after-enter` / `-unpassed` / `-gone`, `start`, `after-x`, `after-del`, `after-send`,
   `question` / `no-question`, `expired` / `no-expiry`, `before-kill`, `final`), written by `save_screens` — live
   into `evidence/screens-{sub}[-{arm}]-{stamp}.json`, a rehearsal into its private dir — scrubbed as the recorder
   scrubs a fixture (the root → `.`, the e2e link's target → `target/e2e-home`, the home → `~`, the user word →
   `<user>`) and checked clean (no `/home/`, no `/tmp/`, no user word); also written on an exception exit.
- Rehearsed under the fake agent, the block 1–8 and 21 `green 9 · red 0` (this run's firing 2), entry 5:
  `… · screens=frames=9,clean=True · modal_arm=modal-refused-no/13/unread/frames=3,clean=True · witness_controls=True · …`
  — the modal arm is entry 10's shape: a wrapped fake in a cwd it does not trust, its modal read off the screen model,
  the trust grant `no` (no key), the send refused, the witness `unread`, the frames kept; the hold arm unchanged
  (`hold_s=60 · deadline_hit=True · duration_ms=60003`). Entry 6:
  `main_screens=frames=3,clean=True · trust-granted_trust=modal-unpassed/2/0 · trust-granted_screens=frames=3,clean=True · trust-refused_trust=modal-refused-no/0/0 · trust-refused_screens=frames=2,clean=True`.

## Step 3c — the kept screens split (plan rev 10; inputs#I22 item 4; run `2026-11-15T09-38-40-implement`)
- Frames are written only under `target/live-round-screens/` (dir 0700, files 0600, gitignored by `.gitignore`'s
  `target/`), by `save_screens` for every session and arm, the modal arm included. One closed-word line per frame is
  appended to `evidence/screens-summary.ndjson`: `v · sub · arm · label · found · selected · rows · sha256 · file ·
  rehearse`. `found` is one of the five words: the trust literal, a selector dialog (`question` after a send,
  `unknown-modal` before), the input box (box-only rows or a footer literal), or `none`.
- Rehearsed, the block 1–8 `green 8 · red 0`. Entry 5 reads
  `screens=frames=9,clean=True,summary=9,closed=True · modal_arm=modal-refused-no/13/unread/frames=3,clean=True,summary=3,closed=True`
  (hold `hold_s=60 · deadline_hit=True · duration_ms=60000`). Entry 6 reads
  `main_screens=frames=3,…,closed=True · trust-granted_trust=modal-unpassed/2/0 · trust-granted_screens=frames=3,…,closed=True · trust-refused_screens=frames=2,…,closed=True`.
  Five frame files stand locally under `target/live-round-screens/`, and none under the work dir or a run dir.
- `screens-check`, the one-shot readings before entry 22's first graded use:
  - must-pass, over the rehearsal's own summary: `screens-check: clean — 20 lines · 20 frames local · 0 deleted`,
    exit 0;
  - must-fail, a scratch copy with one line's `found` set to a row of screen text: `screens-check: red — open-found`,
    exit 1;
  - must-fail, a planted `screens-*.json` in a scratch copy of the work dir's layout:
    `screens-check: red — frame-file-landed`, exit 1;
  - the scratch layout's own control, that summary with an empty scratch work dir: `clean`, exit 0.
- The classifier on synthetic rows (no session): a `❯ 1. Yes, I trust this folder` dialog reads `trust-dialog`,
  selected 0. A numbered selector reads `question` at the `question` label (selected 0) and `unknown-modal` at
  `start`. Blank rows read `none`.
- Entry 21 `stamp-check: pass — stamped 2.1.325 · 21 of 21 relied pass · stamps sha256 86f763d8f43f5281 · start rows 5 ·

# Founder forks — wrap 2026-11-15T11-38-30 of 2026-11-15-live-round-on-the-trimmed-product (P2 halt, the away form)

The wrap stopped at P2's Escalate halt with this ONE question. No answer card: the one escalated operation lies only
partly inside the founder's recorded answers (below). Every other operation of P2 is dispositioned in
`fanout-results.md`, and fit has judged each. Nothing lands until this is answered.

## Q1 — security-plan · `decision/live-round-rig-keys-own-pty` (a boundary widening) · fit: fits type 1

**The proposal** (`ops-security-plan.md` n=1, area `authentication-authorization`):
- name: Live-round rig keys only into its own pty
- rule: A live round's rig passes the folder-trust dialog and the input box only by keys typed into its own pty, and
  reads statusLine.command only by a read-only hash; viola itself types into no dialog.
- why: A ratified boundary widening; a rig is no viola, so the product's own pty seam stays unchanged.

**Why it escalated:** it is a boundary widening (rules `rul-r74hshif`, `rul-p2zl2kgl`), which never lands without
the founder's own word. His recorded words are P4 fork 2, «Разрешить обе (Recommended)», and fork 5, «Разрешить
чтение (Recommended)» (relayed verbatim by overseer1, inputs#I5). They were given «for THIS chunk only», with bounds:
at most 2 down-arrows and 1 Enter, and one `x` and one DEL. The row states a STANDING rule for every later live round,
without those bounds. That reaches past his answer, so a card confirm cannot carry it. The precedent rows
`decision/live-plugin-install-round` and `decision/plugin-install-live-round-rig` (2026-10-18) are standing rules of
the same form, and the plan's expected amendment 3 asked for this add «in the 2026-10-18 form».

**Options, in order:**
1. **Add the row as proposed (Recommended).** A standing rule beside the 2026-10-18 precedent rows, as the plan's
   expected amendment asked. A later live round's rig may then type trust and input-box keys into its own pty and
   hash-read `statusLine.command` without a new fork. Cost: it widens beyond «this chunk only» on this one word.
2. **Add it with this chunk's bounds named in the rule** (at most 2 down-arrows and 1 Enter on the trust literal; one
   `x` and one DEL into the input box; a read-only hash of `statusLine.command`). The proposer is re-spawned with that
   direction and the row is judged by fit again. Still standing, but bounded as he bounded it.
3. **Keep it out of the master.** The widening stays this chunk's alone, recorded by its sidecar entry and the report,
   and every later live round asks its own fork again.

**Answer:** _(the founder's own word, appended here verbatim; then snapped `--message-file --kind relay` and cited as
`inputs#I{n}` on the line `decision/live-round-rig-keys-own-pty · … · resolved: … (Q1)`)_

The founder's own selection, given in overseer1's question dialog at 2026-11-15T12:15Z, relayed verbatim by overseer1
and read by the Viola overseer in that session's transcript (`~/dev/projects/additional/viola-overseer/relay-wrap-live-round-q1.md`),
verbatim: «С границами и словом на чанк (Recommended)»

So option 2: the row lands with this chunk's bounds named in the rule (at most two down-arrows and one Enter, only on
the trust literal; one `x` and one DEL in the input box) and a per-chunk word of the founder each time, through fit.

body:
## 2026-11-15-live-round-on-the-trimmed-product — 8. Cognitive Accessibility: 1 row(s)
**Section:** 8. Cognitive Accessibility
**Change:** ~ decision/dialog-hold-bounds-the-driver · state: was «provisional»; now «standing»
**Why:** decision/dialog-hold-bounds-the-driver: The dialog hold was applied ahead of its ratification, and the ceiling is now measured live with the hold ruled to stand and the dialog read on the screen after expiry, so the row's provisional state leaves it while its rule already says the dialog renders for the human at the hold's end.
**Ref:** .andromeda/runs/2026-11-15T11-38-30-wrap/

- On the CLI, state is always a printed word (`stale`, `DIALOG <kind>`, `expired`, `unverified-cli`, the STATUS words `idle` / `busy` on joined wrapped rows and the unwrapped rows' `n/a` cells; on a terminal too narrow only an unwrapped NAME is cut, to the column less 3 characters plus `...` and never inside a `\xHH` escape, a wrapped NAME never, and piped output and `--json` keep every name whole); colour is a second cue only (amber SGR only on `DIALOG`, dim on stale rows, bold only on NAME values, always beside the word), `unable` / `fail` are never coloured, and viola emits no SGR of its own under non-TTY / `NO_COLOR` (an empty value included) / `TERM=dumb` / `--json` / a passthrough role / `viola run` / a passed `viola revive`, and `viola link` / `viola unlink` print one plain-ASCII result line in one write with no SGR in any mode. viola has no web or graphical frontend, so no page token pair or layout to verify.

The shared vocabulary of every other crate: the normalised event kinds, `RefusalReason` and its closed detail sets (`HumanTyping { ManualPause }` among them), `UnreachableCause` (`StrictModes` · `InstanceDead` · `UnwrappedName` · `EndpointLost` · `ServerVerify` · `SocketDir`, each word through `as_str`, `SocketDir`'s `socket-dir-refused`: exit 21's closed cause set, with no serde path, the two clients writing every word, and no `RefusalReason`), the wheel's `WheelCause` (`start` · `human-input` · `manual-pause` · `release`), the nutype newtypes `ViolaName` and `DialogHold` (whole seconds 60–3600), the protocol `v` constants, the shared validators (`validate_paste_text`, and `is_code_word`: 1 to 64 bytes of `[a-z0-9-]`, a lower-case letter first), the `MAX_FRAME` constant (16 MiB), `SPINE_DEADLINE` (1 s, the spine bound the perf gate reads), `DIALOG_HOLD_DEFAULT` · `DIALOG_HOLD_MIN` · `DIALOG_HOLD_MAX` (60 s · 60 s · 3600 s: the dialog hold's default and bounds, `config.json`'s `dialog_hold_s` read once at the wrapper's start into a `DialogHold`; the hook bounds its reply read at `DIALOG_HOLD_MAX + 5 s`, below the `hooks.json` `timeout` of 3615), the injected `Clock` seam (`SystemClock` in production; first consumer `run`'s vt100 feed thread), `SERVICE_NAME` / `VERSION`, and the obs vocabulary (`obs_event!`, `ObsEvent`, `ObsProcess`). It performs no I/O and depends on no viola crate. It does NOT know Claude payload shapes (that is `viola-agent-claude`), and it does not depend on `tracing`: `obs_event!` expands to `::tracing::event!` at the caller.

_Crate implementation notes. Primary source: `doc:architecture` §Crate dependency direction, [Human Takeover / Wheel], [Session Liveness] (start order), [Deployment / Distribution], [CLI Conventions]; obs §3 Init order, §7 Panic hooks. Generated by `/andromeda-setup-project`._

- Test homes on the Linux dev host (the founder's live answer, 2026-10-07T07:25Z, relayed by the overseer; a boundary widening): `target/e2e-home` is a link to the per-user tmpfs directory `/tmp/viola-e2e-home-<uid>`, so the fixture chain's sweep and drop and harness `cleanup` create and delete outside the working directory, each only a dir the test side itself made. The two keepers follow a linked base only when its target is absolute and one `lstat` reads a real directory with no group or other bit, and refuse a backing whose filesystem reads less than the 9 GiB headroom floor free (`statvfs`), each refusal a fixed message that names no path (the headroom one holds the two counts); they create it 0700 and remove nothing. `viola` never names the backing; no CI runner has the link. Accepted residual (a live round of `viola plugin install`): the round runs the CLI's own four commands (`claude plugin marketplace add` / `install` / `uninstall` / `marketplace remove`) at `--scope local`, a fresh count of four per rig, from a `proj/` that is its own git repo outside this work tree (on the e2e-home tmpfs, no ancestor `CLAUDE.md`): the CLI takes the local scope's project from the git work tree root, and a `proj/` inside the work tree meets the external-imports dialog after the trust dialog; the rig passes the folder-trust dialog by keys into its own pty only, never a desktop key (on a read screen at most 2 arrows toward the trust row and 1 Enter only when that row reads selected, any other screen no key; on a wrapped start the keys move the wheel to the human, and `viola release <name>` precedes the driver's send); the CLI's writes are its own — its trust entry in `~/.claude.json` for each `proj/` whose dialog was accepted, the session transcripts under `~/.claude/projects/`, and after the removal its orphaned plugin cache `~/.claude/plugins/cache/viola/viola/<version>/` (re-written in place by a later install and uninstall), `installed_plugins.json` and `known_marketplaces.json` back as before (as measured on claude 2.1.287 at chunk 2026-10-18-plugin-precedence-live-readings); viola itself writes nothing under `~/.claude` or into `~/.claude.json`. Accepted residual (a scratch footer reading of a newer CLI): one `viola run` start of the CLI under a tmpfs `--home`, in a detached 80×24 pane, its cwd a fresh `.viola-footer-<pid>/` under the repository root, with no key typed; one `viola list` read against that home; at two instants the pane's bottom three screen rows, scrubbed of the home and the user word, written to the chunk's `evidence/`, never a row above the footer; then the start is killed and its cwd removed; it left no transcript under `~/.claude/projects/` (as measured on 2.1.302 at chunk 2026-10-19-newer-claude-cli-rows). It is no product path and no standing permission: another such reading needs its own answer. A live session's screen frames are kept only under a gitignored local path, never in a work dir, a run dir or a commit; what lands is a closed-word summary per frame.

- Home: 0700 dirs, 0600 files via `OpenOptionsExt::mode` (pinned `bin/<version>-<hash>/viola` is 0700); the event log, heartbeat and diagnostics files' owner-only append open never follows a symbolic link (a link at the path is a failed open) and sets 0600 through the open handle; every replaced file goes through the one helper `viola_state::fs::replace_private` (tempfile `persist`), which sets the temp file's mode before any byte is written; the pinned `viola` is never replaced: its absent copy goes through `viola_state::fs::place_private_new` (mode 0700 set before any byte, `sync_all`, the write handle closed, then `persist_noclobber`, never over a present name), and a copy another start placed first is re-hashed before reuse, different bytes left as found. Strict-modes check (mode/owner, ssh StrictModes style) at every entry point that reads `snapshot.json` or `ledger/stamps.json`, before its first read or open under the home (`run`, `revive`'s start and `verify` through `check_home_tree` before their log opens, exit 1; `viola list`'s `board::scan` through `check_read` on the home (a home another user may read refused with or without an instance), `check_path` on `instances/` and `check_instance` per instance, the whole board refused, exit 21; the frame verbs through `check_instance`, exit 21; the diagnostics opens through `check_diagnostics`, a refusal a failed open), refusing also a home, instance directory or `diagnostics/` another user can read (any group or other bit, `mode & 0o077 != 0`) and a symlinked `diagnostics/` folder or file, and in `viola plugin install` on its home and each existing `marketplace/` tree dir before anything is created or opened (exit 21), and at the start of `viola mcp` on its home (exit 1, nothing on stdout or stderr, no role file); `marketplace/` is no trusted file and its installed `command` is not re-hashed (`marketplace/` is off the integrity set).

- **Path 1 — `run` start sequence** — event order `wheel{start}` → `session-start` (the last start record, with a `wheel{holder:"human", cause:"human-input"}` record before it where folder-trust keys pass through the wrapper, a later human key adding none, with "Hooks to normalised events"); the home-tree strict-modes check runs before the wrapper log opens; duplicate / squatted / tampered-exe starts, a refused socket directory (Unix, checked before the bind) and a refused home tree exit 1; plugin files rewritten with absolute pinned paths

- 0600 files in 0700 dirs; `OpenOptions::append`; one `write_all` per complete line (concurrent hook processes share a file). A failed log write is swallowed — `hook` still exits 0. `open_role_file` and `write_detail` (`src/obs.rs`) run `strict::check_diagnostics` on the existing `diagnostics/` folder and on the role or detail file before `ensure_private_dir` narrows anything (a symlink refused, a folder held to the read rule, a file to the read rule, an absent path passing): a refusal is a failed open — `viola_obs_init` returns the error and installs no subscriber (`hook` carries on writing no line, every other role, `mcp` included, returns the error) and the detail line is dropped.

`python -X utf8 ~/.claude/skills/andromeda-tools/scripts/rec.py seal --root . --run-dir .andromeda/runs/2026-11-15T11-38-30-wrap`

own … left as files`, exit 0; `--run 2026-11-15T12-35-39-implement --dry-run` → the same refusal, exit 3.
